anger.name: 怒火

Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.

造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。

beam cell.name: 光束電池

big bang.name: 宇宙大爆炸

Choose another player.
The next {ImitationLearningPower:diff()} times they play a Power, you play a copy of it.
imitation learning.tr:
選擇另一名玩家。
該玩家接下來 {ImitationLearningPower:diff()} 次打出能力牌時，你都會打出一張該牌的複製品。

immortality.name: 不朽
immortality.tr:
失去 {HpLoss:diff()} 點生命。
獲得 {IntangiblePower:diff()} 層[gold]無形[/gold]。

impale.name: 貫穿
impale.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
施加 {PoisonPower:diff()} 層[gold]中毒[/gold]。

impatience.name: 急躁
impatience.en: If you have no Attacks in your [gold]Hand[/gold], draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
impatience.tr: 若你的[gold]手牌[/gold]中沒有攻擊牌，抽 {Cards:diff()} 張牌。

infection.name: 感染
infection.en: At the end of your turn, if this is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], take {Damage:diff()} damage.
infection.tr: 在你的回合結束時，若此牌在你的[gold]手牌[/gold]中，受到 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。

infernal blade.name: 地獄之刃
infernal blade.en: Add a random Attack into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this turn.
infernal blade.tr: 將一張隨機攻擊牌加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。本回合可免費打出。

inferno.name: 煉獄
inferno.en:
At the start of your turn, lose 1 HP.
Whenever you lose HP on your turn, deal {InfernoPower:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
inferno.tr:
在你的回合開始時，失去 1 點生命。
每當你在自己的回合失去生命時，對所有敵人造成 {InfernoPower:diff()} 點傷害。

infinite blades.name: 無盡刀刃
infinite blades.en: At the start of your turn, add 1 [gold]Shiv[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
infinite blades.tr: 在你的回合開始時，將 1 張[gold]小刀[/gold]加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

intercept.name: 攔截
intercept.en:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Redirect all incoming attacks that would be dealt to another player this turn to you.
intercept.tr:
獲得 {Block:diff()} 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。
本回合將原本指向另一名玩家的所有攻擊轉移至你。

invoke.name: 喚起
invoke.tr: 下回合，[gold]召喚[/gold] {Summon:diff()} 並獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。

iron wave.name: 鐵斬波
iron wave.tr:
獲得 {Block:diff()} 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。

iteration.name: 迭代
iteration.en: The first time you draw a Status each turn, draw {IterationPower:diff()} {IterationPower:plural:card|cards}.
iteration.tr: 每回合第一次抽到狀態牌時，抽 {IterationPower:diff()} 張牌。

i am invincible.name: 所向無敵
i am invincible.en:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
At the end of your turn, if this is on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], play it.
i am invincible.tr:
獲得 {Block:diff()} 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。
在你的回合結束時，若此牌位於你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]頂部，將其打出。

jackpot.name: 大獎
jackpot.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add {Cards:diff()} random{IfUpgraded:show: [gold]Upgraded[/gold]} 0{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} {Cards:plural:card|cards} into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
jackpot.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
將 {Cards:diff()} 張{IfUpgraded:show:[gold]已升級[/gold]且}耗能為 0{energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} 的隨機卡牌加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

jack of all trades.name: 萬事通
jack of all trades.tr: 將 {Cards:diff()} 張隨機無色牌加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

juggernaut.name: 勢不可擋
juggernaut.en: Whenever you gain [gold]Block[/gold], deal {JuggernautPower:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
juggernaut.tr: 每當你獲得[gold]格擋[/gold]時，對一名隨機敵人造成 {JuggernautPower:diff()} 點傷害。

juggling.name: 雜耍
juggling.en: Add a copy of the third [gold]Attack[/gold] you play each turn into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
juggling.tr: 將你每回合打出的第三張[gold]攻擊牌[/gold]的一張複製品會加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

kingly kick.name: 王者之踢
kingly kick.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Whenever you draw this card, reduce its cost by 1.
kingly kick.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
每當你抽到此牌時，就使其耗能減少 1 點。

kingly punch.name: 王者之拳
kingly punch.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Whenever you draw this card, increase its damage by {Increase:diff()} this combat.
kingly punch.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
本場戰鬥中，每當你抽到此牌時，其傷害就提高 {Increase:diff()} 點。

knife trap.name: 刀刃陷阱
knife trap.en:
{IfUpgraded:show:[gold]Upgrade[/gold] and play|Play} every [gold]Shiv[/gold] in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold] on the enemy.{InCombat:
(Plays {CalculatedShivs:diff()} [gold]{CalculatedShivs:plural:Shiv|Shivs}[/gold])|}
knife trap.tr:
以該敵人為目標，{IfUpgraded:show:[gold]升級[/gold]並打出|打出}你[gold]消耗堆[/gold]中每一張[gold]小刀[/gold]。{InCombat:
（打出 {CalculatedShivs:diff()} 張[gold]小刀[/gold]）|}

knockdown.name: 擊倒
knockdown.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
The enemy takes {IfUpgraded:show:triple|double} damage from other players this turn.
knockdown.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
本回合該敵人受到其他玩家的傷害變為{IfUpgraded:show:三倍|兩倍}。

knockout blow.name: 終結重拳
knockout blow.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
If this kills an enemy, gain {Stars:starIcons()}.
knockout blow.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
若此牌殺死敵人，就獲得 {Stars:starIcons()}。

know thy place.name: 休得僭越
know thy place.tr:
施加 {WeakPower:diff()} 層[gold]虛弱[/gold]。
施加 {VulnerablePower:diff()} 層[gold]易傷[/gold]。

lantern key.name: 燈火鑰匙
lantern key.en: Unlocks a special event in the next Act.
lantern key.tr: 解鎖下一幕中的特殊事件。

largesse.name: 慷慨賞賜
largesse.en: Another player adds 1 random{IfUpgraded:show: [gold]Upgraded[/gold]} Colorless card to their [gold]Hand[/gold].
largesse.tr: 另一名玩家將 1 張隨機{IfUpgraded:show:[gold]已升級[/gold]的}無色牌加入其[gold]手牌[/gold]。

leading strike.name: 先導打擊
leading strike.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
將 {Shivs:diff()} 張[gold]小刀[/gold]加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

leg sweep.name: 掃腿
leg sweep.tr:
施加 {WeakPower:diff()} 層[gold]虛弱[/gold]。
獲得 {Block:diff()} 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

lethality.name: 殺傷性
lethality.en: The first Attack each turn deals {LethalityPower:diff()}% additional damage.
lethality.tr: 每回合第一張攻擊牌的傷害提高 {LethalityPower:diff()}%。

lift.name: 托舉
lift.tr: 使另一名玩家獲得 {Block:diff()} 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

lightning rod.name: 引雷針
lightning rod.en:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
At the start of the next {LightningRodPower:plural:turn|{:diff()} turns}, [gold]Channel[/gold] 1 [gold]Lightning[/gold].
lightning rod.tr:
獲得 {Block:diff()} 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。
{LightningRodPower:choose:下回合|接下來 {:diff()} 個回合}開始時，[gold]凝聚[/gold] 1 個[gold]閃電[/gold]。

loop.name: 循環
loop.en: At the start of your turn, trigger the passive ability of your rightmost Orb{IfUpgraded:show: 2 times}.
loop.tr: 在你的回合開始時，觸發你最右側充能球的被動能力{IfUpgraded:show: 2 次}。

lunar blast.name: 月面轟射
lunar blast.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage for each Skill already played this turn.{InCombat:
(Hits {CalculatedHits:diff()} {CalculatedHits:plural:time|times})|}
lunar blast.tr:
本回合每打出過一張技能牌，就造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。{InCombat:
（擊中 {CalculatedHits:diff()} 次）|}

machine learning.name: 機器學習
machine learning.en: At the start of your turn, draw {Cards:diff()} additional {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
machine learning.tr: 在你的回合開始時，額外抽 {Cards:diff()} 張牌。

make it so.name: 如此甚好
make it so.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Every {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:Skill|Skills} you play in a turn, put this into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
make it so.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
每回合每打出 {Cards:diff()} 張技能牌，就將此牌放入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

malaise.name: 萎靡
malaise.tr: 敵人失去 X{IfUpgraded:show:+1} 層[gold]力量[/gold]。施加 X{IfUpgraded:show:+1} 層[gold]虛弱[/gold]。

mangle.name: 重創
mangle.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Enemy loses {StrengthLoss:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
mangle.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
敵人本回合失去 {StrengthLoss:diff()} 層[gold]力量[/gold]。

manifest authority.name: 彰顯權威
manifest authority.en:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Add 1 random{IfUpgraded:show: [gold]Upgraded[/gold]} Colorless card into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
manifest authority.tr:
獲得 {Block:diff()} 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。
將 1 張隨機{IfUpgraded:show:[gold]已升級[/gold]的}無色牌加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

master planner.name: 謀劃專家
master planner.en: When you play a Skill, it gains [gold]Sly[/gold].
master planner.tr: 當你打出一張技能牌時，該牌獲得[gold]奇巧[/gold]。

maul.name: 猛襲
maul.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage twice.
Increase the damage of ALL Maul cards by {Increase:diff()} this combat.
maul.tr:
造成 2 次 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
本場戰鬥中，所有猛襲牌的傷害提高 {Increase:diff()} 點。

mayhem.name: 亂戰
mayhem.en: At the start of your turn, play the top card of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
mayhem.tr: 在你的回合開始時，打出你[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]頂部的牌。

melancholy.name: 憂鬱
melancholy.en:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Reduce this card's cost by {Energy:energyIcons()} whenever ANYONE dies.
melancholy.tr:
獲得 {Block:diff()} 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。
每當任何人死亡時，此牌耗能減少 {Energy:energyIcons()}。

memento mori.name: 銘記死亡
memento mori.en:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each card discarded this turn.
memento mori.tr:
造成 {CalculatedDamage:diff()} 點傷害。
本回合每丟棄過一張牌，就額外造成 {ExtraDamage:diff()} 點傷害。

metamorphosis.name: 蛻變
metamorphosis.en: Add {Cards:diff()} random Attacks into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. They're free to play this combat.
metamorphosis.tr: 將 {Cards:diff()} 張隨機攻擊牌加入你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]。本場戰鬥中可免費打出。

meteor shower.name: 流星雨
meteor shower.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
Apply {WeakPower:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] and [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies.
meteor shower.tr:
對所有敵人造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
對所有敵人施加 {WeakPower:diff()} 層[gold]虛弱[/gold]和[gold]易傷[/gold]。

meteor strike.name: 隕石打擊
meteor strike.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
[gold]凝聚[/gold] 3 個[gold]電漿[/gold]。

midnight.name: 午夜
midnight.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Costs 1 less {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} for each card [gold]Exhausted[/gold] this combat by ANYONE.
midnight.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
本場戰鬥中，每當任何人[gold]消耗[/gold]一張牌，此牌耗能就減少 1 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}。

mimic.name: 模仿
mimic.en: Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to the [gold]Block[/gold] on another player.
mimic.tr: 獲得與另一名玩家的[gold]格擋[/gold]值相同的[gold]格擋[/gold]。

mind blast.name: 心靈轟射
mind blast.en:
Deal damage equal to the number of cards in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].{InCombat:
(Deals {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage)|}
mind blast.tr:
造成與你[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]中的卡牌數量相同的傷害。{InCombat:
（造成 {CalculatedDamage:diff()} 點傷害）|}

minion strike.name: 手下打擊
minion strike.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
抽 {Cards:diff()} 張牌。

mirage.name: 海市蜃樓
mirage.en:
Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to [gold]Poison[/gold] on ALL enemies.{InCombat:
(Gain {CalculatedBlock:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold])|}
mirage.tr:
獲得與所有敵人[gold]中毒[/gold]層數等量的[gold]格擋[/gold]。{InCombat:
（獲得 {CalculatedBlock:diff()} 點[gold]格擋[/gold]）|}

misery.name: 苦難
misery.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Apply any debuffs on the enemy to ALL other enemies.
misery.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
將該敵人身上的所有弱化效果施加給所有其他敵人。

modded.name: 模組改造
modded.en:
Gain {Repeat:diff()} Orb {Repeat:plural:Slot|Slots}.
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}. Increase this card's cost by 1.
modded.tr:
獲得 {Repeat:diff()} 個充能球欄位。
抽 {Cards:diff()} 張牌。此牌耗能增加 1 點。

molten fist.name: 熔融之拳
molten fist.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
使敵人的[gold]易傷[/gold]加倍。

momentum strike.name: 動量打擊
momentum strike.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Reduce this card's cost to 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
momentum strike.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
使此牌耗能降為 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}。

monarch's gaze.name: 王之凝視
monarch's gaze.en: Whenever you attack an enemy, it loses {StrengthLoss:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
monarch's gaze.tr: 每當你攻擊一名敵人時，該敵人本回合失去 {StrengthLoss:diff()} 層[gold]力量[/gold]。

monologue.name: 獨白
monologue.en: Whenever you play a card this turn, gain {Power:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
monologue.tr: 本回合每當你打出一張牌時，獲得 {Power:diff()} 層[gold]力量[/gold]。

multi-cast.name: 多重施放
multi-cast.tr: [gold]激發[/gold]你最右側的充能球 {IfUpgraded:show:X+1|X} 次。

murder.name: 謀殺
murder.en:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each card drawn this combat.
murder.tr:
造成 {CalculatedDamage:diff()} 點傷害。
本場戰鬥中每抽一張牌，就額外造成 {ExtraDamage:diff()} 點傷害。

necro mastery.name: 亡靈精通
necro mastery.en:
[gold]Summon[/gold] {Summon:diff()}.
Whenever [gold]Osty[/gold] loses HP,
ALL enemies lose that much HP as well.
necro mastery.tr:
[gold]召喚[/gold] {Summon:diff()}。
每當[gold]奧斯提[/gold]失去生命時，
所有敵人也失去等量生命。

negative pulse.name: 負能脈衝
negative pulse.tr:
獲得 {Block:diff()} 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。
對所有敵人施加 {DoomPower:diff()} 層[gold]惡兆[/gold]。

neow's fury.name: 涅奧之怒
neow's fury.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Put up to {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
neow's fury.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
將你[gold]棄牌堆[/gold]中最多 {Cards:diff()} 張牌放入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

neurosurge.name: 神經湧動
neurosurge.en:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
At the start of your turn, apply {NeurosurgePower:diff()} [gold]Doom[/gold] to yourself.
neurosurge.tr:
獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。
抽 {Cards:diff()} 張牌。
在你的回合開始時，對自己施加 {NeurosurgePower:diff()} 層[gold]惡兆[/gold]。

neutralize.name: 中和
neutralize.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
施加 {WeakPower:diff()} 層[gold]虛弱[/gold]。

nightmare.name: 夢魘
nightmare.en:
Choose a card.
Next turn, add 3 copies of that card into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
nightmare.tr:
選擇一張牌。
下回合，將該牌的 3 張複製牌加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

normality.name: 凡庸
normality.en:
You cannot play more than 3 cards this turn.{InCombat:
({CalculatedCards:plural:{} card|{} cards} left)|}
normality.tr:
本回合你最多只能打出 3 張牌。{InCombat:
（還剩 {CalculatedCards} 張牌）|}

nostalgia.name: 懷舊
nostalgia.en: The first Attack or Skill you play each turn is placed on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
nostalgia.tr: 你每回合打出的第一張攻擊牌或技能牌會被放到你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]頂部。

noxious fumes.name: 毒霧
noxious fumes.en: At the start of your turn, apply {PoisonPerTurn:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies.
noxious fumes.tr: 在你的回合開始時，對所有敵人施加 {PoisonPerTurn:diff()} 層[gold]中毒[/gold]。

no escape.name: 無處可逃
no escape.en:
Apply {CalculationBase:diff()} [gold]Doom[/gold], plus an additional {CalculationExtra:diff()} [gold]Doom[/gold] for every {DoomThreshold:diff()} [gold]Doom[/gold] already on this enemy.{IsTargeting:
(Apply {CalculatedDoom:diff()} [gold]Doom[/gold])|}
no escape.tr:
施加 {CalculationBase:diff()} 層[gold]惡兆[/gold]，該敵人原本每有 {DoomThreshold:diff()} 層[gold]惡兆[/gold]，就額外施加 {CalculationExtra:diff()} 層[gold]惡兆[/gold]。{IsTargeting:
（施加 {CalculatedDoom:diff()} 層[gold]惡兆[/gold]）|}

null.name: 歸零
null.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
施加 {WeakPower:diff()} 層[gold]虛弱[/gold]。
[gold]凝聚[/gold] 1 個[gold]黑暗[/gold]。

oblivion.name: 湮滅
oblivion.en: Whenever you play a card this turn, apply {DoomPower:diff()} [gold]Doom[/gold] to the enemy.
oblivion.tr: 本回合每當你打出一張牌時，對敵人施加 {DoomPower:diff()} 層[gold]惡兆[/gold]。

offering.name: 祭品
offering.tr:
失去 {HpLoss:diff()} 點生命。
獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。
抽 {Cards:diff()} 張牌。

off by one.name: 一線之差
off by one.en: If you end your turn with exactly 1 card in your [gold]Hand[/gold], gain an additional {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of next turn.
off by one.tr: 若你結束回合時[gold]手牌[/gold]正好有 1 張牌，則下回合開始時額外獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。

omnislice.name: 萬向斬
omnislice.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Damage ALL other enemies equal to the damage dealt.
omnislice.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
對所有其他敵人造成等量的傷害。

one for all.name: 一為全
one for all.tr: 所有人的 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} 攻擊牌額外造成 {OneForAllPower:diff()} 點傷害。

one-two punch.name: 連環拳
one-two punch.en: This turn, your next {Attacks:cond:>1?{Attacks:diff()} Attacks are|Attack is} played an extra time.
one-two punch.tr: 本回合你打出的下 {Attacks:diff()} 張攻擊牌會額外打出一次。

outbreak.name: 毒疫爆發
outbreak.en:
Apply {PoisonPower:diff()} [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies.
[gold]Poison[/gold] triggers immediately.
outbreak.tr:
對所有敵人施加 {PoisonPower:diff()} 層[gold]中毒[/gold]。
[gold]中毒[/gold]會被立即觸發。

outrage.name: 暴怒
outrage.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add a copy of this card into EVERYONE'S [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
outrage.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
將此牌的一張複製品加入每個人的[gold]棄牌堆[/gold]。

overclock.name: 超頻
overclock.en:
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Add a [gold]Burn[/gold] into your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
overclock.tr:
抽 {Cards:diff()} 張牌。
將一張[gold]灼傷[/gold]加入你的[gold]棄牌堆[/gold]。

pact's end.name: 契約終結
pact's end.en:
If you have {Cards:diff()} or more {Cards:plural:card|cards} in your [gold]Exhaust Pile[/gold],
deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
pact's end.tr:
若你的[gold]消耗堆[/gold]中有不少於 {Cards:diff()} 張牌，
對所有敵人造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。

pael's strike.name: 佩爾打擊
pael's strike.en:
Deal damage equal to the number of cards in your [gold]Deck[/gold].{InCombat:
(Deals {Damage:diff()} damage)|}
pael's strike.tr:
造成與你[gold]牌組[/gold]中的卡牌數量相同的傷害。{InCombat:
（造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害）|}

pagestorm.name: 書頁風暴
pagestorm.en: Whenever you draw an [gold]Ethereal[/gold] card, draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
pagestorm.tr: 每當你抽到一張[gold]虛無[/gold]牌時，抽 {Cards:diff()} 張牌。

pale blue dot.name: 暗淡藍點
pale blue dot.en: If you play {CardPlay} or more cards in a turn, draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} at the start of your next turn.
pale blue dot.tr: 若你在一回合內打出不少於 {CardPlay} 張牌，則在下回合開始時抽 {Cards:diff()} 張牌。

panache.name: 瀟灑制勝
panache.en: Every time you play 5 cards in a single turn, deal {PanacheDamage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies.
panache.tr: 每當你在單一回合內打出 5 張牌時，對所有敵人造成 {PanacheDamage:diff()} 點傷害。

panic button.name: 應急按鈕
panic button.en:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
You cannot gain [gold]Block[/gold] from cards for {Turns:diff()} {Turns:plural:turn|turns}.
panic button.tr:
獲得 {Block:diff()} 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。
接下來 {Turns:diff()} 個回合，你無法從卡牌獲得[gold]格擋[/gold]。

parry.name: 招架
parry.tr: [gold]君王之劍[/gold]現在會獲得 {ParryPower:diff()} 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

particle wall.name: 粒子牆
particle wall.en:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Return this card to your [gold]Hand[/gold].
particle wall.tr:
獲得 {Block:diff()} 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。
將此牌放回你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

patter.name: 星點輕敲
patter.tr:
獲得 {Block:diff()} 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。
獲得 {VigorPower:diff()} 層[gold]活力[/gold]。

peck.name: 啄擊
peck.tr: 造成 {Repeat:diff()} 次 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。

perfected strike.name: 完美打擊
perfected strike.en:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for ALL your cards containing “Strike”.
perfected strike.tr:
造成 {CalculatedDamage:diff()} 點傷害。
你的牌中每有一張名稱包含「打擊」的牌，就額外造成 {ExtraDamage:diff()} 點傷害。

phantom blades.name: 幻影之刃
phantom blades.en:
[gold]Shivs[/gold] gain [gold]Retain[/gold].
The first [gold]Shiv[/gold] you play each turn deals {PhantomBladesPower:diff()} additional damage.
phantom blades.tr:
[gold]小刀[/gold]獲得[gold]保留[/gold]。
你每回合打出的第一張[gold]小刀[/gold]額外造成 {PhantomBladesPower:diff()} 點傷害。

photon cut.name: 光子切割
photon cut.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Put 1 card from your [gold]Hand[/gold] on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
photon cut.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
抽 {Cards:diff()} 張牌。
將你[gold]手牌[/gold]中的 1 張牌放到[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]頂部。

piercing wail.name: 刺耳尖嚎
piercing wail.tr: 所有敵人本回合失去 {StrengthLoss:diff()} 層[gold]力量[/gold]。

pillage.name: 搶掠
pillage.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw cards until you draw a non-Attack card.
pillage.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
持續抽牌，直到抽到一張非攻擊牌。

pillar of creation.name: 創造之柱
pillar of creation.en: Whenever you create a card, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
pillar of creation.tr: 你每次創造一張牌時，獲得 {Block:diff()} 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

pinpoint.name: 精密瞄準
pinpoint.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Costs 1 less {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} for each Skill played this turn.
pinpoint.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
本回合每打出一張技能牌，此牌耗能就減少 1 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}。

pity.name: 憐憫
pity.en:
Fully heal an enemy.
Gain {singleStarIcon} for every {Hp:inverseDiff()} HP healed.
pity.tr:
使一名敵人完全恢復生命。
每恢復 {Hp:inverseDiff()} 點生命，就獲得 {singleStarIcon}。

plot.name: 謀劃
plot.en: Next turn, ALL players draw {Cards} cards.
plot.tr: 下回合，所有玩家抽 {Cards} 張牌。

poisoned stab.name: 帶毒刺擊
poisoned stab.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
施加 {PoisonPower:diff()} 層[gold]中毒[/gold]。

pommel strike.name: 劍柄打擊
pommel strike.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
抽 {Cards:diff()} 張牌。

pounce.name: 撲擊
pounce.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
The next Skill you play costs 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
pounce.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
你打出的下一張技能牌耗能為 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}。

precise cut.name: 精確切割
precise cut.en:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:inverseDiff()} less damage for each other card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
precise cut.tr:
造成 {CalculatedDamage:diff()} 點傷害。
你[gold]手牌[/gold]中每有一張其他牌，就少造成 {ExtraDamage:inverseDiff()} 點傷害。

predator.name: 獵殺者
predator.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Next turn, draw 2 cards.
predator.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
下回合，抽 2 張牌。

prepared.name: 早有準備
prepared.tr:
抽 {Cards:diff()} 張牌。
丟棄 {Cards:diff()} 張牌。

prep time.name: 準備時間
prep time.en: At the start of your turn, gain {PrepTimePower:diff()} [gold]Vigor[/gold].
prep time.tr: 在你的回合開始時，獲得 {PrepTimePower:diff()} 層[gold]活力[/gold]。

primal force.name: 原始力量
primal force.en: Transform all Attacks in your [gold]Hand[/gold] into [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Giant Rock+|Giant Rock}[/gold].
primal force.tr: 將你[gold]手牌[/gold]中的所有攻擊牌轉化為[gold]{IfUpgraded:show:巨石+|巨石}[/gold]。

prolong.name: 延長
prolong.en: Next turn, gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to your current [gold]Block[/gold].
prolong.tr: 下回合，獲得與你目前的[gold]格擋[/gold]值相同的[gold]格擋[/gold]。

protector.name: 護衛者
protector.en:
[gold]Osty[/gold] deals {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals additional damage equal to [gold]Osty's[/gold] [gold]Max HP[/gold].
protector.tr:
[gold]奧斯提[/gold]造成 {CalculatedDamage:diff()} 點傷害。
額外造成與[gold]奧斯提[/gold]的[gold]最大生命[/gold]等量的傷害。

prowess.name: 非凡技藝
prowess.tr:
獲得 {StrengthPower:diff()} 層[gold]力量[/gold]。
獲得 {DexterityPower:diff()} 層[gold]敏捷[/gold]。

pull from below.name: 幽冥牽引
pull from below.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage for each [gold]Ethereal[/gold] card played this combat.{InCombat:
(Hits {CalculatedHits:diff()} {CalculatedHits:plural:time|times})|}
pull from below.tr:
本場戰鬥中每打出過一張[gold]虛無[/gold]牌，就造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。{InCombat:
（擊中 {CalculatedHits:diff()} 次）|}

purity.name: 純淨
purity.en: Exhaust up to {Cards:diff()} cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
purity.tr: 消耗你[gold]手牌[/gold]中最多 {Cards:diff()} 張牌。

putrefy.name: 腐敗
putrefy.tr:
施加 {Power:diff()} 層[gold]虛弱[/gold]。
施加 {Power:diff()} 層[gold]易傷[/gold]。

pyre.name: 燃火
pyre.en: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.

quadcast.name: 四重施放
quadcast.tr: [gold]激發[/gold]你最右側的充能球 {Repeat:diff()} 次。

quasar.name: 類星體
quasar.en: Choose 1 of 3 random{IfUpgraded:show: [gold]Upgraded[/gold]|} Colorless cards to add into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
quasar.tr: 從 3 張隨機{IfUpgraded:show:[gold]已升級[/gold]的|}無色牌中選擇 1 張加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

quick slash.name: 快捷斬擊
quick slash.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
抽 1 張牌。

radiate.name: 輻射
radiate.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies for each {Stars:starIcons()} gained this turn.{InCombat:
(Hits {CalculatedHits:diff()} {CalculatedHits:plural:time|times})|}
radiate.tr:
本回合每獲得 {Stars:starIcons()}，就對所有敵人造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。{InCombat:
（擊中 {CalculatedHits:diff()} 次）|}

rage.name: 狂怒
rage.en: Whenever you play an Attack this turn, gain {Power:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
rage.tr: 本回合每當你打出一張攻擊牌時，獲得 {Power:diff()} 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

rainbow.name: 彩虹
rainbow.tr:
[gold]凝聚[/gold] 1 個[gold]閃電[/gold]。
[gold]凝聚[/gold] 1 個[gold]冰霜[/gold]。
[gold]凝聚[/gold] 1 個[gold]黑暗[/gold]。

rally.name: 集結
rally.tr: 所有玩家獲得 {Block:diff()} 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

rampage.name: 暴走
rampage.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Increase this card's damage by {Increase:diff()} this combat.
rampage.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
本場戰鬥中，此牌傷害提高 {Increase:diff()} 點。

rattle.name: 猛晃

reaper form.name: 死神形態
reaper form.en: Whenever Attacks deal damage, apply that much [gold]Doom[/gold].
reaper form.tr: 每當攻擊牌造成傷害時，施加等量[gold]惡兆[/gold]。

reave.name: 剝奪
reave.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Add a [gold]{IfUpgraded:show:Soul+|Soul}[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
reave.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
將一張[gold]{IfUpgraded:show:靈魂+|靈魂}[/gold]加入你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]。

reboot.name: 重新啟動
reboot.en:
Shuffle ALL your cards into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
reboot.tr:
將你的所有牌洗入[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]。
抽 {Cards:diff()} 張牌。

rebound.name: 回彈
rebound.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Put the next card you play this turn on top of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
rebound.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
將你本回合打出的下一張牌放到你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]頂部。

reflect.name: 反射
reflect.en:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Blocked attack damage is reflected to your attacker this turn.
reflect.tr:
獲得 {Block:diff()} 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。
在本回合將被格擋的攻擊傷害反射給攻擊者。

refract.name: 折射
refract.tr:
造成 2 次 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
[gold]凝聚[/gold] {Repeat:diff()} 個[gold]玻璃[/gold]。

regret.name: 悔恨
regret.en: At the end of your turn, if this is in your [gold]Hand[/gold], lose 1 HP for each card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
regret.tr: 在你的回合結束時，若此牌在你的[gold]手牌[/gold]中，則[gold]手牌[/gold]每有 1 張牌就失去 1 點生命。

relax.name: 放鬆
relax.en:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
Next turn, draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards} and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
relax.tr:
獲得 {Block:diff()} 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。
下回合，抽 {Cards:diff()} 張牌並獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。

rend.name: 撕扯破碎
rend.en:
Deal {CalculatedDamage:diff()} damage.
Deals {ExtraDamage:diff()} additional damage for each unique debuff on the enemy.
rend.tr:
造成 {CalculatedDamage:diff()} 點傷害。
敵人身上每有一種不同的弱化效果，就額外造成 {ExtraDamage:diff()} 點傷害。

reserves.name: 儲備
reserves.en: If you don't have enough {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} for a card, 2{singleStarIcon} are used per {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} instead.
reserves.tr: 若你沒有足夠的 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} 打出卡牌，則每缺少 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}，改用 2 個 {singleStarIcon} 支付。

resonance.name: 共振
resonance.tr: 獲得 {StrengthPower:diff()} 層[gold]力量[/gold]。所有敵人失去 1 層[gold]力量[/gold]。

restlessness.name: 心神不寧
restlessness.en: If your [gold]Hand[/gold] is empty, draw {Cards:diff()} cards and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
restlessness.tr: 若你的[gold]手牌[/gold]為空，抽 {Cards:diff()} 張牌並獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。

ricochet.name: 彈射
ricochet.en: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy {Repeat:diff()} times.
ricochet.tr: 對一名隨機敵人造成 {Repeat:diff()} 次 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。

right hand hand.name: 助手之手
right hand hand.en:
[gold]Osty[/gold] deals {OstyDamage:diff()} damage.
Whenever you play a card that costs {Energy:energyIcons()} or more, return this to your [gold]Hand[/gold] from the [gold]Discard Pile[/gold].
right hand hand.tr:
[gold]奧斯提[/gold]造成 {OstyDamage:diff()} 點傷害。
每當你打出一張耗能不少於 {Energy:energyIcons()} 的牌時，將此牌從[gold]棄牌堆[/gold]放回你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

rip and tear.name: 撕裂猛扯
rip and tear.en: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy twice.
rip and tear.tr: 對一名隨機敵人造成 2 次 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。

rocket punch.name: 火箭飛拳
rocket punch.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw {Cards:diff()} {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
Whenever you create a Status, reduce this card's cost by 1 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} until played.
rocket punch.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
抽 {Cards:diff()} 張牌。
每當你創造一張狀態牌時，使此牌耗能降低 1 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}，直到打出為止。

rolling boulder.name: 滾動巨石
rolling boulder.en: At the start of your turn, deal {RollingBoulderPower:diff()} damage to ALL enemies and increase this damage by {IncrementAmount:diff()}.
rolling boulder.tr: 在你的回合開始時，對所有敵人造成 {RollingBoulderPower:diff()} 點傷害，並使此傷害提高 {IncrementAmount:diff()} 點。

royalties.name: 王室權利金
royalties.en: At the end of combat, gain {Gold:diff()} [gold]Gold[/gold].
royalties.tr: 戰鬥結束時，獲得 {Gold:diff()} 枚[gold]金幣[/gold]。

rupture.name: 綻裂
rupture.en: Whenever you lose HP on your turn, gain {StrengthPower:diff()} [gold]Strength[/gold].
rupture.tr: 每當你在自己的回合失去生命時，獲得 {StrengthPower:diff()} 層[gold]力量[/gold]。

sacrifice.name: 犧牲
sacrifice.en:
If [gold]Osty[/gold] is alive, he dies and you gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to triple his Max HP.{InCombat:
(Gain {IsOstyAlive:{CalculatedBlock:diff()}|0} [gold]Block[/gold])|}
sacrifice.tr:
若[gold]奧斯提[/gold]存活，他會死亡，且你獲得等量於其最大生命三倍的[gold]格擋[/gold]。{InCombat:
（獲得 {IsOstyAlive:{CalculatedBlock:diff()}|0} 點[gold]格擋[/gold]）|}

salvo.name: 齊射
salvo.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
本回合[gold]保留[/gold]你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

scavenge.name: 搜刮
scavenge.tr:
[gold]消耗[/gold]一張牌。
下回合，獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。

scourge.name: 鞭笞
scourge.tr:
施加 {DoomPower:diff()} 層[gold]惡兆[/gold]。
抽 {Cards:diff()} 張牌。

scrape.name: 刮削
scrape.en:
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage.
Draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
Discard all cards drawn this way that do not cost 0 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
scrape.tr:
造成 {Damage:diff()} 點傷害。
