blessed antler.en: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. At the start of each combat, shuffle [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]Dazed[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
blessed antler.tr: 每回合開始時，獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。每場戰鬥開始時，將 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張[gold]暈眩[/gold]牌洗入你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]。

blood-soaked rose.name: 血染玫瑰
blood-soaked rose.en: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [red]Enthralled[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.
blood-soaked rose.tr: 拾取時，將 [blue]1[/blue] 張[red]執迷[/red]加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]。每回合開始時，獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。

blood vial.name: 血瓶
blood vial.en: At the start of each combat, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
blood vial.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，恢復 [green]{Heal}[/green] 點生命。

bone flute.name: 骨笛
bone flute.tr: 每當[gold]奧斯提[/gold]攻擊時，獲得 [blue]{Block}[/blue] 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

bone tea.name: 骨茶
bone tea.en: At the start of the next {Combats:plural:combat|[blue]{}[/blue] combats}, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] your starting hand.
bone tea.tr: 接下來 [blue]{Combats}[/blue] 場戰鬥開始時，[gold]升級[/gold]你的起始手牌。

bookmark.name: 書籤
bookmark.en: At the end of each turn, lower the cost of a random [gold]Retained[/gold] card by [blue]1[/blue] until played.
bookmark.tr: 回合結束時，使一張隨機[gold]保留[/gold]牌的耗能降低 [blue]1[/blue] 點，直到被打出為止。

book of five rings.name: 五輪書
book of five rings.en: Every [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} you add to your [gold]Deck[/gold], heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
book of five rings.tr: 你每將 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]，就恢復 [green]{Heal}[/green] 點生命。

book repair knife.name: 修書刀
book repair knife.en: Whenever a non-Minion enemy dies to [gold]Doom[/gold], heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
book repair knife.tr: 每當一名非手下敵人因[gold]惡兆[/gold]死亡時，恢復 [green]{Heal}[/green] 點生命。

booming conch.name: 轟鳴海螺
booming conch.en: At the start of [gold]Elite[/gold] combats, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards} and gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
booming conch.tr: [gold]菁英[/gold]戰鬥開始時，額外抽 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌並獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。

bound phylactery.name: 禁縛命匣
bound phylactery.en: At the start of your turn, [gold]Summon[/gold] [blue]{Summon}[/blue].
bound phylactery.tr: 在你的回合開始時，[gold]召喚[/gold] [blue]{Summon}[/blue]。

bread.name: 麵包
bread.en: At the start of your first turn, lose {LoseEnergy:energyIcons()}. At the start of all other turns, gain {GainEnergy:energyIcons()}.
bread.tr: 你的第一個回合開始時，失去 {LoseEnergy:energyIcons()}。此後每個回合開始時，獲得 {GainEnergy:energyIcons()}。

brilliant scarf.name: 璀璨圍巾
brilliant scarf.en: The [blue]5th[/blue] card you play from your hand each turn is free.
brilliant scarf.tr: 你每回合從手牌打出的第 [blue]5[/blue] 張牌可免費打出。

brimstone.name: 硫磺
brimstone.en: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]{SelfStrength}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and ALL enemies gain [blue]{EnemyStrength}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
brimstone.tr: 在你的回合開始時，獲得 [blue]{SelfStrength}[/blue] 層[gold]力量[/gold]，且所有敵人獲得 [blue]{EnemyStrength}[/blue] 層[gold]力量[/gold]。

bronze scales.name: 青銅鱗片
bronze scales.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，獲得 [blue]{ThornsPower}[/blue] 層[gold]荊棘[/gold]。

burning blood.name: 燃燒之血
burning blood.en: At the end of combat, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
burning blood.tr: 戰鬥結束時，恢復 [green]{Heal}[/green] 點生命。

burning sticks.name: 燃燒木棍
burning sticks.en: The first time each combat you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a Skill, add a copy of it into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
burning sticks.tr: 每場戰鬥中你第一次[gold]消耗[/gold]技能牌時，將該牌的一張複製品加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

byrdpip.name: 異鳥雛鳥
byrdpip.en: Upon pickup, gain the card [gold]Byrd Swoop[/gold]. A [gold]Byrdpip[/gold] will accompany you in battles.
byrdpip.tr: 拾取時，獲得[gold]異鳥俯衝[/gold]卡牌。一隻[gold]異鳥雛鳥[/gold]會陪你戰鬥。

calling bell.name: 召喚鈴鐺
calling bell.en: Upon pickup, obtain a unique [red]Curse[/red] and [blue]{Relics}[/blue] [gold]Relics[/gold].
calling bell.tr: 拾取時，獲得一張獨特的[red]詛咒[/red]和 [blue]{Relics}[/blue] 件[gold]遺物[/gold]。

candelabra.name: 枝形燭臺
candelabra.en: At the start of your [blue]2nd[/blue] turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
candelabra.tr: 你的第 [blue]2[/blue] 個回合開始時，獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。

captain's wheel.name: 船長舵輪
captain's wheel.en: At the start of your [blue]3rd[/blue] turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
captain's wheel.tr: 你的第 [blue]3[/blue] 個回合開始時，獲得 [blue]{Block}[/blue] 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

cauldron.name: 大鍋
cauldron.tr: 拾取時，釀製 [blue]{Potions}[/blue] 瓶隨機[gold]藥水[/gold]。

centennial puzzle.name: 百年積木
centennial puzzle.en: The first time you lose HP each combat, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
centennial puzzle.tr: 每場戰鬥中你第一次失去生命時，抽 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌。

chandelier.name: 吊燈
chandelier.en: At the start of your [blue]3rd[/blue] turn, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
chandelier.tr: 你的第 [blue]3[/blue] 個回合開始時，獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。

charon's ashes.name: 卡戎之灰
charon's ashes.en: Whenever you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
charon's ashes.tr: 每當你[gold]消耗[/gold]一張牌時，對所有敵人造成 [blue]{Damage}[/blue] 點傷害。

chemical x.name: 化學物 X
chemical x.en: The effects of your cost [blue]X[/blue] cards are increased by [blue]{Increase}[/blue].
chemical x.tr: 你的耗能為 [blue]X[/blue] 的卡牌效果提高 [blue]{Increase}[/blue]。
chemical x.flavor: 警告：請勿與糖、香料和一切美好事物混合。

choices paradox.name: 選擇悖論
choices paradox.en: At the start of each combat, add [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random cards into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. Add [gold]Retain[/gold] to the chosen card.
choices paradox.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，從 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張隨機卡牌中選擇 [blue]1[/blue] 張加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]，並為所選牌附加[gold]保留[/gold]。

the chosen cheese.name: 天選起司
the chosen cheese.en: At the end of combat, gain [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] Max HP.
the chosen cheese.tr: 戰鬥結束時，獲得 [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] 點最大生命。

circlet.name: 頭環
circlet.flavor: 一件奇特的遺物。當[gold]尖塔[/gold]內發生問題，或再也沒有遺物可供發現時，它就會出現。

claws.name: 利爪
claws.tr: 拾取時，將最多 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌[gold]轉化[/gold]為[gold]猛襲[/gold]。

cloak clasp.name: 斗篷扣
cloak clasp.en: At the end of your turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] for each card in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
cloak clasp.tr: 你的回合結束時，[gold]手牌[/gold]中每有一張牌，就獲得 [blue]{Block}[/blue] 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

cracked core.name: 破損核心
cracked core.en: At the start of each combat, [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]{Lightning}[/blue] [gold]Lightning[/gold].
cracked core.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，[gold]凝聚[/gold] [blue]{Lightning}[/blue] 個[gold]閃電[/gold]。

crossbow.name: 十字弓
crossbow.en: At the start of your turn, add a random [gold]Attack[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this turn.
crossbow.tr: 在你的回合開始時，將一張隨機[gold]攻擊牌[/gold]加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。本回合可免費打出。

cursed kettle.name: 詛咒水壺
cursed kettle.en: Whenever you defeat an [gold]Elite[/gold], the other [gold]Elites[/gold] in the act will gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] at the start of combat.
cursed kettle.tr: 每當你擊敗一名[gold]菁英[/gold]時，本幕中的其他[gold]菁英[/gold]會在戰鬥開始時獲得 [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] 層[gold]力量[/gold]。

cursed pearl.name: 詛咒珍珠
cursed pearl.tr: 拾取時，獲得[red]貪婪[/red]。獲得 [blue]{Gold}[/blue] 枚[gold]金幣[/gold]。

darkstone periapt.name: 黑石護符
darkstone periapt.en: Whenever you obtain a [red]Curse[/red], raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
darkstone periapt.tr: 每當你獲得一張[red]詛咒[/red]時，使你的最大生命提高 [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] 點。

data disk.name: 資料磁碟
data disk.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，獲得 [blue]{FocusPower}[/blue] 層[gold]集中[/gold]。

daughter of the wind.name: 風之女兒
daughter of the wind.en: Whenever you play an Attack, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
daughter of the wind.tr: 每當你打出一張攻擊牌時，獲得 [blue]{Block}[/blue] 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

delicate frond.name: 纖細葉片
delicate frond.en: At the start of each combat, fill all empty potion slots with random [gold]Potions[/gold].
delicate frond.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，以隨機[gold]藥水[/gold]填滿所有空的藥水欄位。

demon tongue.name: 惡魔之舌
demon tongue.en: The first time you lose HP on your turn, heal HP equal to the amount lost.
demon tongue.tr: 你每回合第一次失去生命時，恢復與該次損失等量的生命。

deprecated relic.name: 已棄用遺物
deprecated relic.en: This relic is no longer in the game. It's just here for legacy purposes.
deprecated relic.tr: 此遺物已不再出現在遊戲中，僅為相容舊內容而保留。

diamond diadem.name: 鑽石冠冕
diamond diadem.en: Start combat with [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold]. Your [gold]Block[/gold] is not removed at the start of your [blue]2nd[/blue] turn.
diamond diadem.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，擁有 [blue]{Block}[/blue] 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。你的第 [blue]2[/blue] 回合開始時不會移除你的[gold]格擋[/gold]。

dingy rug.name: 骯髒地毯
dingy rug.en: Card rewards can now contain Colorless cards.
dingy rug.tr: 卡牌獎勵現在可能包含無色牌。

distinguished cape.name: 尊貴披風
distinguished cape.en: Upon pickup, add [blue]{Curses}[/blue] random [red]Curses[/red] and [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]{Cards:plural:Apparition|Apparitions}[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
distinguished cape.tr: 拾取時，將 [blue]{Curses}[/blue] 張隨機[red]詛咒[/red]與 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張[gold]靈體[/gold]加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]。

divine destiny.name: 神授天命
divine destiny.en: At the start of each combat, gain {Stars:starIcons()}.

divine right.name: 神授君權
divine right.en: At the start of each combat, gain {Stars:starIcons()}.

dolly's mirror.name: 多利之鏡
dolly's mirror.en: Upon pickup, obtain an additional copy of a card in your [gold]Deck[/gold].
dolly's mirror.tr: 拾取時，獲得你[gold]牌組[/gold]中一張牌的複製品。

dowsing rod.name: 探尋杖
dowsing rod.tr: 拾取時，將 [blue]1[/blue] 張[gold]探尋[/gold]加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]。

dragon fruit.name: 火龍果
dragon fruit.en: Whenever you gain [gold]Gold[/gold], raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
dragon fruit.tr: 每當你獲得[gold]金幣[/gold]時，使你的最大生命提高 [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] 點。

dream catcher.name: 捕夢網
dream catcher.en: Whenever you [gold]Rest[/gold], you may add a card to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
dream catcher.tr: 每當你[gold]休息[/gold]時，可以將一張牌加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]。

driftwood.name: 浮木
driftwood.en: You may reroll each card reward once.
driftwood.tr: 每份卡牌獎勵可重骰一次。

ectoplasm.name: 靈質
ectoplasm.en: You can no longer gain [gold]Gold[/gold]. Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.
ectoplasm.tr: 你無法再獲得[gold]金幣[/gold]。每回合開始時，獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。

electric shrymp.name: 放電異蝦
electric shrymp.tr: 拾取時，為一張技能牌[gold]附魔[/gold]上[purple]灌注[/purple]。

ember tea.name: 餘燼茶
ember tea.en: At the start of the next {Combats:plural:combat|[blue]{}[/blue] combats}, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
ember tea.tr: 接下來 [blue]{Combats}[/blue] 場戰鬥開始時，獲得 [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] 層[gold]力量[/gold]。

emotion chip.name: 情感晶片
emotion chip.en: If you lost HP during the previous turn, trigger the passive ability of all Orbs at the start of your turn.
emotion chip.tr: 若你在上一回合失去過生命，則在你的回合開始時觸發所有充能球的被動能力。

empty cage.name: 空鳥籠
empty cage.tr: 拾取時，從你的[gold]牌組[/gold]中移除 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌。

endless appetite.name: 無盡食慾
endless appetite.tr: 每當你[gold]消耗[/gold]一張牌時，獲得 [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] 層[gold]力量[/gold]。

eternal feather.name: 永恆羽毛
eternal feather.en: For every {Cards:plural:card|[blue]{}[/blue] cards} in your [gold]Deck[/gold], heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP whenever you enter a [gold]Rest Site[/gold].
eternal feather.tr: 你的[gold]牌組[/gold]中每有 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌，進入[gold]休息處[/gold]時就恢復 [green]{Heal}[/green] 點生命。

anchor???.name: 錨？？？
anchor???.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，獲得 [blue]{Block}[/blue] 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

blood vial???.name: 血瓶？？？
blood vial???.en: At the start of each combat, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
blood vial???.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，恢復 [green]{Heal}[/green] 點生命。

happy flower???.name: 開心小花？？？
happy flower???.tr: 每經過 [blue]{Turns}[/blue] 回合，就獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。

lee's waffle???.name: 李家鬆餅？？？
lee's waffle???.en: Upon pickup, heal [green]{Heal}%[/green] of your HP.
lee's waffle???.tr: 拾取時，恢復 [green]{Heal}%[/green] 的生命。

mango???.name: 芒果？？？
mango???.en: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
mango???.tr: 拾取時，使你的最大生命提高 [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] 點。

the merchant's rug???.name: 商人的地毯？？？
the merchant's rug???.tr: 拙劣的仿製品。毫無作用。

orichalcum???.name: 奧利哈鋼？？？
orichalcum???.en: If you end your turn without [gold]Block[/gold], gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
orichalcum???.tr: 若你結束回合時沒有[gold]格擋[/gold]，就獲得 [blue]{Block}[/blue] 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

snecko eye???.name: 異蛇之眼？？？
snecko eye???.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時處於[red]混亂[/red]狀態。

strike dummy???.name: 打擊木偶？？？
strike dummy???.tr: 名稱中含有「打擊」的卡牌額外造成 [blue]{ExtraDamage}[/blue] 點傷害。

venerable tea set???.name: 古老茶具組？？？
venerable tea set???.en: Whenever you enter a [gold]Rest Site[/gold], start the next combat with an additional {Energy:energyIcons()}.
venerable tea set???.tr: 每當你進入[gold]休息處[/gold]時，下一場戰鬥開始時額外獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。

fencing manual.name: 擊劍手冊
fencing manual.en: At the start of each combat, [gold]Forge[/gold] [blue]{Forge}[/blue].

festive popper.name: 節慶拉炮
festive popper.en: At the start of each combat, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
festive popper.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，對所有敵人造成 [blue]{Damage}[/blue] 點傷害。

fiddle.name: 小提琴
fiddle.en: At the start of each turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards}. You may not draw cards during your turn.
fiddle.tr: 每回合開始時，額外抽 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌。你的回合期間無法抽牌。

fishing rod.name: 釣竿
fishing rod.en: Every {Combats:plural:normal combat|[blue]{}[/blue] normal combats}, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] a random card in your [gold]Deck[/gold].
fishing rod.tr: 每經過 [blue]{Combats}[/blue] 場普通戰鬥，就[gold]升級[/gold]你[gold]牌組[/gold]中的一張隨機卡牌。

forgotten soul.name: 被遺忘之魂
forgotten soul.en: Whenever you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
forgotten soul.tr: 每當你[gold]消耗[/gold]一張牌時，對一名隨機敵人造成 [blue]{Damage}[/blue] 點傷害。

fragrant mushroom.name: 芳香蘑菇
fragrant mushroom.en: Upon pickup, lose [blue]{HpLoss}[/blue] HP and [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
fragrant mushroom.tr: 拾取時，失去 [blue]{HpLoss}[/blue] 點生命，並[gold]升級[/gold] [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張隨機卡牌。

fresnel lens.name: 菲涅耳透鏡
fresnel lens.en: Whenever you add a card that gains [gold]Block[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold], [gold]Enchant[/gold] it with [purple]Nimble[/purple] [blue]{NimbleAmount}[/blue].
fresnel lens.tr: 每當你將一張可獲得[gold]格擋[/gold]的牌加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]時，為其[gold]附魔[/gold]上[purple]靈巧[/purple] [blue]{NimbleAmount}[/blue]。

frozen egg.name: 冰凍之蛋
frozen egg.en: Whenever you add a Power into your [gold]Deck[/gold], [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it.
frozen egg.tr: 每當你將一張能力牌加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]時，將其[gold]升級[/gold]。

funerary mask.name: 葬禮面具
funerary mask.en: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]{Cards:plural:Soul|Souls}[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
funerary mask.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，將 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張[gold]靈魂[/gold]加入你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]。

fur coat.name: 毛皮大衣
fur coat.en: Upon pickup, mark [blue]{Combats}[/blue] random combats. Enemies in those rooms have [blue]1[/blue] HP.
fur coat.tr: 拾取時，標記 [blue]{Combats}[/blue] 場隨機戰鬥。這些房間中的敵人只有 [blue]1[/blue] 點生命。

galactic dust.name: 銀河塵埃
galactic dust.tr: 每花費 [blue]{Stars}[/blue] 個 {singleStarIcon}，就獲得 [blue]{Block}[/blue] 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

gambling chip.name: 賭博籌碼
gambling chip.en: At the start of each combat, discard any number of cards then draw that many.
gambling chip.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，可以丟棄任意數量的牌，然後抽取等量的牌。

game piece.name: 棋子
game piece.en: Whenever you play a Power, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
game piece.tr: 每當你打出一張能力牌時，抽 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌。

girya.name: 壺鈴
girya.en: You can now gain [gold]Strength[/gold] at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold]. ([blue]3[/blue] times max)
girya.tr: 你現在可以在[gold]休息處[/gold]獲得[gold]力量[/gold]。（最多 [blue]3[/blue] 次）

glass eye.name: 玻璃眼
glass eye.en: Upon pickup, obtain [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Common[/gold] cards, [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Uncommon[/gold] cards, and [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Rare[/gold] card.
glass eye.tr: 拾取時，獲得 [blue]2[/blue] 張[gold]普通[/gold]牌、[blue]2[/blue] 張[gold]罕見[/gold]牌與 [blue]1[/blue] 張[gold]稀有[/gold]牌。

glitter.name: 亮粉
glitter.tr: 為所有卡牌獎勵中的卡牌[gold]附魔[/gold]上[purple]華彩[/purple]。

glowing orb.name: 發光法球
glowing orb.tr: 每場[gold]菁英[/gold]戰鬥開始時，額外獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。

gnarled hammer.name: 多節戰鎚
gnarled hammer.tr: 拾取時，為最多 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張攻擊牌[gold]附魔[/gold]上[purple]鋒利[/purple] [blue]{SharpAmount:diff()}[/blue]。

golden compass.name: 黃金羅盤
golden compass.en: Upon pickup, replace the [gold]Act[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] Map with a single special path.
golden compass.tr: 拾取時，將[gold]第[/gold] [blue]2[/blue] [gold]幕[/gold]地圖替換為一條特殊路徑。

golden pearl.name: 黃金珍珠
golden pearl.tr: 拾取時，獲得 [blue]{Gold}[/blue] 枚[gold]金幣[/gold]。

gold-plated cables.name: 鍍金纜線
gold-plated cables.en: Your rightmost Orb triggers its passive an additional time.
gold-plated cables.tr: 你最右側充能球的被動能力會額外觸發一次。

gorget.name: 護頸甲
gorget.en: At the start of each combat, gain [blue]{PlatingPower}[/blue] [gold]Plating[/gold].
gorget.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，獲得 [blue]{PlatingPower}[/blue] 層[gold]鍍甲[/gold]。

gremlin horn.name: 地精之角
gremlin horn.en: Whenever an enemy dies, gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
gremlin horn.tr: 每當一名敵人死亡時，獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()} 並抽 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌。

hand drill.name: 手鑽
hand drill.en: Whenever you break an enemy's [gold]Block[/gold], apply [blue]{VulnerablePower}[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold].
hand drill.tr: 每當你破除敵人的[gold]格擋[/gold]時，施加 [blue]{VulnerablePower}[/blue] 層[gold]易傷[/gold]。

happy flower.name: 開心小花
happy flower.tr: 每經過 [blue]{Turns}[/blue] 回合，就獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。

hefty tablet.name: 沉重石板
hefty tablet.en: Upon pickup, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Rare cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold], and add [blue]1[/blue] [red]Injury[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
hefty tablet.tr: 拾取時，從 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張稀有牌中選擇 [blue]1[/blue] 張加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]，並將 [blue]1[/blue] 張[red]受傷[/red]加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]。

helical dart.name: 螺旋鏢
helical dart.en: Whenever you play a [gold]Shiv[/gold], gain [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold] this turn.
helical dart.tr: 每當你打出一張[gold]小刀[/gold]時，本回合獲得 [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] 層[gold]敏捷[/gold]。

history course.name: 歷史課
history course.en: At the start of your turn, play a copy of your last played Attack.
history course.tr: 你的回合開始時，打出一張你上個打出攻擊牌的複製品。

horn cleat.name: 羊角繫纜栓
horn cleat.en: At the start of your [blue]2nd[/blue] turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
horn cleat.tr: 你的第 [blue]2[/blue] 個回合開始時，獲得 [blue]{Block}[/blue] 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

ice cream.name: 冰淇淋
ice cream.en: Energy is now conserved between turns.
ice cream.tr: 能量現在會保留至下回合。

infused core.name: 注能核心
infused core.en: At the start of each combat, [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]{Lightning}[/blue] [gold]Lightning[/gold]. [gold]Lightning[/gold] deals [blue]{ExtraDamage}[/blue] additional damage.
infused core.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，[gold]凝聚[/gold] [blue]{Lightning}[/blue] 個[gold]閃電[/gold]。[gold]閃電[/gold]額外造成 [blue]{ExtraDamage}[/blue] 點傷害。

ink bottle.name: 墨水瓶
ink bottle.tr: 你每打出 [blue]{CardThreshold}[/blue] 張牌，就抽 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌。

intimidating helmet.name: 威嚇頭盔
intimidating helmet.en: Whenever you play a card that costs {Energy:energyIcons()} or more, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
intimidating helmet.tr: 每當你打出一張耗能不少於 {Energy:energyIcons()} 的牌時，獲得 [blue]{Block}[/blue] 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

iron club.name: 鐵棒
iron club.tr: 你每打出 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌，就抽 [blue]1[/blue] 張牌。

ivory tile.name: 象牙麻將牌
ivory tile.en: Whenever you play a card that costs {EnergyThreshold:energyIcons()} or more, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
ivory tile.tr: 每當你打出一張耗能不少於 {EnergyThreshold:energyIcons()} 的牌時，獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。

jeweled mask.name: 珠寶面具
jeweled mask.en: At the start of each combat, put a random Power from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this combat.
jeweled mask.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，將你[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]中的一張隨機能力牌放入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。本場戰鬥可免費打出。

jewelry box.name: 珠寶盒
jewelry box.tr: 拾取時，將 [blue]1[/blue] 張[gold]神化[/gold]加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]。

joss paper.name: 金紙
joss paper.en: Every [blue]{ExhaustAmount}[/blue] times you [gold]Exhaust[/gold] a card, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
joss paper.tr: 每當你[gold]消耗[/gold]卡牌達 [blue]{ExhaustAmount}[/blue] 次時，抽 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌。

juzu bracelet.name: 佛珠手環
juzu bracelet.en: Regular enemy combats are no longer encountered in [gold]?[/gold] rooms.
juzu bracelet.tr: [gold]？[/gold]房間中不會再遇到普通敵人戰鬥。

kaleidoscope.name: 萬花筒
kaleidoscope.en: Upon pickup, obtain [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card reward|card rewards} from other characters.
kaleidoscope.tr: 拾取時，獲得其他角色的 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 份卡牌獎勵。

kifuda.name: 木札
kifuda.tr: 拾取時，為最多 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌[gold]附魔[/gold]上[purple]俐落[/purple]。

kunai.name: 苦無
kunai.en: Every time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Attacks in a single turn, gain [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
kunai.tr: 每當你在單一回合中打出 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張攻擊牌時，獲得 [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] 層[gold]敏捷[/gold]。

kusarigama.name: 鎖鎌
kusarigama.en: Every time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:Attack|Attacks} in a single turn, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
kusarigama.tr: 每當你在單一回合中打出 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張攻擊牌時，對一名隨機敵人造成 [blue]{Damage}[/blue] 點傷害。

lantern.name: 燈籠
lantern.en: Start each combat with an additional {Energy:energyIcons()}.
lantern.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，額外獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。

large capsule.name: 巨大扭蛋
large capsule.en: Upon pickup, obtain [blue]{Relics}[/blue] random [gold]{Relics:plural:Relic|Relics}[/gold]. Add an additional [gold]Strike[/gold] and [gold]Defend[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
large capsule.tr: 拾取時，獲得 [blue]{Relics}[/blue] 件隨機[gold]遺物[/gold]。將一張額外的[gold]打擊[/gold]與[gold]防禦[/gold]加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]。

lasting candy.name: 持久糖果
lasting candy.en: Every other combat, your card rewards gain an additional Power.
lasting candy.tr: 每隔一場戰鬥，你的卡牌獎勵就會多一張能力牌。

lava lamp.name: 熔岩燈
lava lamp.en: At the end of combat, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] all card rewards if you took no damage.
lava lamp.tr: 戰鬥結束時，若你未受到傷害，[gold]升級[/gold]所有卡牌獎勵。

lava rock.name: 熔岩石
lava rock.tr: 第 1 幕頭目會掉落 [blue]{Relics}[/blue] 件[gold]遺物[/gold]。

lead paperweight.name: 鉛製紙鎮
lead paperweight.en: Upon pickup, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]2[/blue] Colorless cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
lead paperweight.tr: 拾取時，從 [blue]2[/blue] 張無色牌中選擇 [blue]1[/blue] 張加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]。

leafy poultice.name: 葉片膏藥
leafy poultice.en: Upon pickup, [gold]Transform[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] of your [gold]Strikes[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] of your [gold]Defends[/gold] and lose [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] Max HP.
leafy poultice.tr: 拾取時，[gold]轉化[/gold]你的 [blue]1[/blue] 張[gold]打擊[/gold]和 [blue]1[/blue] 張[gold]防禦[/gold]，並失去 [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] 點最大生命。

lee's waffle.name: 李家鬆餅
lee's waffle.en: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] and heal all of your HP.
lee's waffle.tr: 拾取時，使你的最大生命提高 [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] 點並完全恢復生命。

letter opener.name: 開信刀
letter opener.en: Every time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:Skill|Skills} in a single turn, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
letter opener.tr: 每當你在單一回合中打出 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張技能牌時，對所有敵人造成 [blue]{Damage}[/blue] 點傷害。

lizard tail.name: 蜥蜴尾巴
lizard tail.en: When your HP would be reduced to [blue]0[/blue], heal to [green]{Heal}%[/green] of your Max HP instead (works once).
lizard tail.tr: 當你的生命即將降至 [blue]0[/blue] 時，改為將生命恢復至最大生命的 [green]{Heal}%[/green]（僅能生效一次）。

looming fruit.name: 織機之果
looming fruit.en: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
looming fruit.tr: 拾取時，使你的最大生命提高 [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] 點。

lord's parasol.name: 領主陽傘
lord's parasol.en: When you encounter the [gold]Merchant[/gold], immediately obtain EVERYTHING he sells.
lord's parasol.tr: 遇到[gold]商人[/gold]時，立即取得他出售的所有物品。

lost coffer.name: 失落寶匣
lost coffer.en: Upon pickup, gain [blue]1[/blue] card reward and procure [blue]1[/blue] random potion.
lost coffer.tr: 拾取時，獲得 [blue]1[/blue] 份卡牌獎勵並取得 [blue]1[/blue] 瓶隨機藥水。

lost wisp.name: 迷途幽火
lost wisp.en: Whenever you play a Power, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
lost wisp.tr: 每當你打出一張能力牌時，對所有敵人造成 [blue]{Damage}[/blue] 點傷害。

lucky fysh.name: 幸運異魚
lucky fysh.en: Whenever you add a card to your [gold]Deck[/gold], gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold].
lucky fysh.tr: 每當你將一張牌加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]時，獲得 [blue]{Gold}[/blue] 枚[gold]金幣[/gold]。

lunar pastry.name: 月亮糕點
lunar pastry.en: At the end of your turn, gain {Stars:starIcons()}.
lunar pastry.tr: 在你的回合結束時，獲得 {Stars:starIcons()}。

mango.name: 芒果
mango.en: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
mango.tr: 拾取時，使你的最大生命提高 [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] 點。

massive scroll.name: 巨型卷軸
massive scroll.en: Upon pickup, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Multiplayer Cards[/gold] to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
massive scroll.tr: 拾取時，從 [blue]3[/blue] 張[gold]多人遊戲卡牌[/gold]中選擇 [blue]1[/blue] 張加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]。

maw bank.name: 巨口撲滿
maw bank.en: Whenever you climb a floor, gain [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold]. No longer works when you spend any [gold]Gold[/gold] at the shop.
maw bank.tr: 每當你爬上一層樓，就獲得 [blue]{Gold}[/blue] 枚[gold]金幣[/gold]。你在商店花費任何[gold]金幣[/gold]後，此效果就不再生效。

meal ticket.name: 餐券
meal ticket.en: Whenever you enter a shop room, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
meal ticket.tr: 每當你進入商店房間時，恢復 [green]{Heal}[/green] 點生命。

meat on the bone.name: 帶骨肉
meat on the bone.en: If your HP is at or below [blue]{HpThreshold}%[/blue] at the end of combat, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
meat on the bone.tr: 若戰鬥結束時你的生命不高於 [blue]{HpThreshold}%[/blue]，就恢復 [green]{Heal}[/green] 點生命。

mercury hourglass.name: 水銀沙漏
mercury hourglass.en: At the start of your turn, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
mercury hourglass.tr: 在你的回合開始時，對所有敵人造成 [blue]{Damage}[/blue] 點傷害。

metronome.name: 節拍器
metronome.en: The first time you [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]{OrbCount}[/blue] [gold]Orbs[/gold] each combat, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
metronome.tr: 每場戰鬥中你第一次[gold]凝聚[/gold] [blue]{OrbCount}[/blue] 個[gold]充能球[/gold]時，對所有敵人造成 [blue]{Damage}[/blue] 點傷害。

miniature cannon.name: 微型大砲
miniature cannon.tr: [gold]已升級[/gold]的攻擊牌額外造成 [blue]{ExtraDamage}[/blue] 點傷害。

miniature tent.name: 微型帳篷
miniature tent.en: You may choose any number of options at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold].
miniature tent.tr: 你可以在[gold]休息處[/gold]選擇任意數量的選項。

mini regent.name: 迷你儲君
mini regent.en: The first time you spend {singleStarIcon} each turn, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
mini regent.tr: 你每回合第一次花費 {singleStarIcon} 時，獲得 [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] 層[gold]力量[/gold]。

molten egg.name: 熔火之蛋
molten egg.en: Whenever you add an Attack card to your [gold]Deck[/gold], [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it.
molten egg.tr: 每當你將一張攻擊牌加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]時，將其[gold]升級[/gold]。

mr. struggles.name: 苦鬥先生
mr. struggles.en: At the start of your turn, deal damage equal to the turn number to ALL enemies.
mr. struggles.tr: 在你的回合開始時，對所有敵人造成與回合數等量的傷害。

mummified hand.name: 木乃伊之手
mummified hand.en: Whenever you play a Power, a random card in your [gold]Hand[/gold] is free to play that turn.
mummified hand.tr: 每當你打出一張能力牌時，你[gold]手牌[/gold]中的一張隨機卡牌可在本回合免費打出。

music box.name: 音樂盒
music box.en: Create an [gold]Ethereal[/gold] copy of the first Attack you play each turn.
music box.tr: 為每回合你打出的第一張攻擊牌創造一張具有[gold]虛無[/gold]的複製品。

mysterious cocoon.name: 神祕蟲繭
mysterious cocoon.en: Upon gaining [blue]{Experience}[/blue] experience, transform [gold]Training Strike[/gold] into [gold]Impale[/gold].
mysterious cocoon.tr: 獲得 [blue]{Experience}[/blue] 點經驗後，將[gold]訓練打擊[/gold]轉化為[gold]貫穿[/gold]。

mystic lighter.name: 秘術打火機
mystic lighter.tr: [gold]已附魔[/gold]的攻擊牌額外造成 [blue]{Damage}[/blue] 點傷害。

neow's bones.name: 涅奧之骨
neow's bones.en: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{Relics}[/blue] random [gold]Neow {Relics:plural:Relic|Relics}[/gold]. Add [blue]{Curses}[/blue] random [red]{Curses:plural:Curse|Curses}[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
neow's bones.tr: 拾取時，獲得 [blue]{Relics}[/blue] 件隨機[gold]涅奧遺物[/gold]。將 [blue]{Curses}[/blue] 張隨機[red]詛咒[/red]加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]。

neow's sacrifice.name: 涅奧的犧牲
neow's sacrifice.en: Upon pickup, procure [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Ambergris[/gold] and add [blue]1[/blue] [red]Guilty[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
neow's sacrifice.tr: 拾取時，取得 [blue]1[/blue] 份[gold]龍涎香[/gold]，並將 [blue]1[/blue] 張[red]愧疚[/red]加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]。

neow's talisman.name: 涅奧的護符
neow's talisman.en: Upon pickup, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] of your [gold]Strikes[/gold] and [blue]1[/blue] of your [gold]Defends[/gold].
neow's talisman.tr: 拾取時，[gold]升級[/gold]你的 [blue]1[/blue] 張[gold]打擊[/gold]和 [blue]1[/blue] 張[gold]防禦[/gold]。

neow's torment.name: 涅奧的苦痛
neow's torment.en: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Neow's Fury[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
neow's torment.tr: 拾取時，將 [blue]1[/blue] 張[gold]涅奧之怒[/gold]加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]。

ninja scroll.name: 忍術卷軸
ninja scroll.en: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Shivs}[/blue] [gold]{Shivs:plural:Shiv|Shivs}[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
ninja scroll.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，將 [blue]{Shivs}[/blue] 張[gold]小刀[/gold]加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

nunchaku.name: 雙節棍
nunchaku.en: Every time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Attacks, gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
nunchaku.tr: 你每打出 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張攻擊牌，就獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。

nutritious oyster.name: 營養牡蠣
nutritious oyster.en: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
nutritious oyster.tr: 拾取時，使你的最大生命提高 [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] 點。

nutritious soup.name: 營養湯
nutritious soup.en: Upon pickup, [gold]Enchant[/gold] all [gold]Strikes[/gold] in your [gold]Deck[/gold] with [purple]Tezcatara's Ember[/purple].
nutritious soup.tr: 拾取時，為你[gold]牌組[/gold]中的所有[gold]打擊[/gold]進行[gold]附魔[/gold]上[purple]特茲卡塔拉的餘燼[/purple]。

oddly smooth stone.name: 異常光滑的石頭
oddly smooth stone.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，獲得 [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] 層[gold]敏捷[/gold]。

old coin.name: 古錢幣
old coin.tr: 拾取時，獲得 [blue]{Gold}[/blue] 枚[gold]金幣[/gold]。

orange dough.name: 橘色團塊
orange dough.en: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random Colorless {Cards:plural:card|cards} into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
orange dough.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，將 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張隨機無色牌加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

orichalcum.name: 奧利哈鋼
orichalcum.en: If you end your turn without [gold]Block[/gold], gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
orichalcum.tr: 若你結束回合時沒有[gold]格擋[/gold]，就獲得 [blue]{Block}[/blue] 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

ornamental fan.name: 精緻扇子
ornamental fan.en: Every time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Attacks in a single turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
ornamental fan.tr: 每當你在單一回合中打出 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張攻擊牌時，獲得 [blue]{Block}[/blue] 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

orrery.name: 星系儀
orrery.tr: 拾取時，獲得 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 份卡牌獎勵。

pael's blood.name: 佩爾之血
pael's blood.en: At the start of your turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
pael's blood.tr: 在你的回合開始時，額外抽 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌。

pael's claw.name: 佩爾之爪
pael's claw.tr: 拾取時，為所有[gold]防禦[/gold]進行[gold]附魔[/gold]上[purple]{EnchantmentName}[/purple]。

pael's eye.name: 佩爾之眼
pael's eye.en: The first time each combat you end your turn without playing cards, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] your [gold]Hand[/gold], and take an extra turn.
pael's eye.tr: 每場戰鬥中你第一次未打出任何牌就結束回合時，[gold]消耗[/gold]你的[gold]手牌[/gold]，並額外進行一個回合。

pael's flesh.name: 佩爾之肉
pael's flesh.en: Gain an additional {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of your [blue]3rd[/blue] turn, and every turn after that.
pael's flesh.tr: 你的第 [blue]3[/blue] 個回合及此後每個回合開始時，額外獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。

pael's horn.name: 佩爾之角
pael's horn.tr: 拾取時，將 [blue]2[/blue] 張[gold]放鬆[/gold]加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]。

pael's legion.name: 佩爾的士兵
pael's legion.en: Doubles [gold]Block[/gold] gained from a card, then goes to sleep for [blue]{Turns}[/blue] {Turns:plural:turn|turns}.
pael's legion.tr: 使一張牌提供的[gold]格擋[/gold]加倍，然後沉睡 [blue]{Turns}[/blue] 回合。

pael's tears.name: 佩爾之淚
pael's tears.en: If you end your turn with unspent {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}, gain an additional {Energy:energyIcons()} next turn.
pael's tears.tr: 若你結束回合時仍有未花費的 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}，下回合額外獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。

pael's tooth.name: 佩爾之牙

pael's wing.name: 佩爾之翼
pael's wing.en: You may sacrifice card rewards to Pael. Every {Sacrifices:plural:sacrifice|[blue]{}[/blue] sacrifices}, obtain a [gold]Relic[/gold].
pael's wing.tr: 你可以將卡牌獎勵獻給佩爾。每犧牲 [blue]{Sacrifices}[/blue] 次，就獲得一件[gold]遺物[/gold]。

pantograph.name: 縮放儀
pantograph.en: At the start of each [gold]Boss[/gold] combat, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
pantograph.tr: 每場[gold]頭目[/gold]戰鬥開始時，恢復 [green]{Heal}[/green] 點生命。

paper krane.name: 紙鶴
paper krane.en: Enemies with [gold]Weak[/gold] deal [blue]40%[/blue] less damage to you rather than [blue]25%[/blue].
paper krane.tr: 處於[gold]虛弱[/gold]狀態的敵人對你造成的傷害減少 [blue]40%[/blue]，而非 [blue]25%[/blue]。

paper phrog.name: 紙異蛙
paper phrog.en: Enemies with [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] take [blue]75%[/blue] more damage rather than [blue]50%[/blue].
paper phrog.tr: 處於[gold]易傷[/gold]狀態的敵人受到的傷害增加 [blue]75%[/blue]，而非 [blue]50%[/blue]。

parrying shield.name: 招架盾牌
parrying shield.en: If you end a turn with at least [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold], deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to a random enemy.
parrying shield.tr: 若你結束回合時至少有 [blue]{Block}[/blue] 點[gold]格擋[/gold]，對一名隨機敵人造成 [blue]{Damage}[/blue] 點傷害。

pear.name: 梨子
pear.en: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
pear.tr: 拾取時，使你的最大生命提高 [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] 點。

pendulum.name: 擺錘
pendulum.tr: 每經過 [blue]{Turns}[/blue] 回合，就抽 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌。

pen nib.name: 鋼筆尖
pen nib.en: Every [blue]10th[/blue] Attack you play deals double damage.
pen nib.tr: 每逢你打出第 [blue]10[/blue] 張攻擊牌，該牌就造成雙倍傷害。

permafrost.name: 永凍冰晶
permafrost.en: The first time you play a Power each combat, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
permafrost.tr: 每場戰鬥中你第一次打出能力牌時，獲得 [blue]{Block}[/blue] 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

petrified toad.name: 石化蟾蜍
petrified toad.en: At the start of each combat, procure a [gold]Potion-Shaped Rock[/gold].
petrified toad.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，取得一顆[gold]藥水形狀的石頭[/gold]。

phial holster.name: 藥瓶套
phial holster.en: Upon pickup, gain [blue]{PotionSlots}[/blue] potion {PotionSlots:plural:slot|slots} and procure [blue]{Potions}[/blue] random [gold]{Potions:plural:Potion|Potions}[/gold].
phial holster.tr: 拾取時，獲得 [blue]{PotionSlots}[/blue] 個藥水欄位，並取得 [blue]{Potions}[/blue] 瓶隨機[gold]藥水[/gold]。

philosopher's stone.name: 賢者之石
philosopher's stone.en: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. ALL enemies start combat with [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
philosopher's stone.tr: 每回合開始時，獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。所有敵人在戰鬥開始時擁有 [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] 層[gold]力量[/gold]。

phylactery unbound.name: 無界命匣
phylactery unbound.en: At the start of each combat, [gold]Summon[/gold] [blue]{StartOfCombat}[/blue]. At the start of your turn, [gold]Summon[/gold] [blue]{StartOfTurn}[/blue].
phylactery unbound.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，[gold]召喚[/gold] [blue]{StartOfCombat}[/blue]。在你的回合開始時，[gold]召喚[/gold] [blue]{StartOfTurn}[/blue]。

planisphere.name: 星座盤
planisphere.en: Whenever you enter a [gold]?[/gold] room, heal [green]{Heal}[/green] HP.
planisphere.tr: 每當你進入[gold]？[/gold]房間時，恢復 [green]{Heal}[/green] 點生命。

pocketwatch.name: 懷錶
pocketwatch.en: Whenever you play [blue]{CardThreshold}[/blue] or fewer {CardThreshold:plural:card|cards} during your turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards} at the start of your next turn.
pocketwatch.tr: 若你在一回合中打出的牌不超過 [blue]{CardThreshold}[/blue] 張，在你的下回合開始時額外抽 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌。

pollinous core.name: 花粉核心
pollinous core.tr: 每經過 [blue]{Turns}[/blue] 回合，就額外抽 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌。

potion belt.name: 藥水腰帶
potion belt.tr: 拾取時，獲得 [blue]{PotionSlots}[/blue] 個藥水欄位。

power cell.name: 能量電池
power cell.en: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] zero-cost cards from your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
power cell.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，將你[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]中的 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張零耗能牌加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

prayer wheel.name: 轉經輪
prayer wheel.en: Normal enemies drop an additional card reward.
prayer wheel.tr: 普通敵人會額外掉落一份卡牌獎勵。

precarious shears.name: 鬆動大剪
precarious shears.en: Upon pickup, remove [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Deck[/gold] and lose [blue]{Damage}[/blue] HP.
precarious shears.tr: 拾取時，從你的[gold]牌組[/gold]中移除 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌，並失去 [blue]{Damage}[/blue] 點生命。

precise scissors.name: 精密剪刀
precise scissors.tr: 拾取時，從你的[gold]牌組[/gold]中移除 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌。

preserved fog.name: 封存活霧
preserved fog.en: Upon pickup, remove [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} from your [gold]Deck[/gold]. Add [red]Folly[/red] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
preserved fog.tr: 拾取時，從你的[gold]牌組[/gold]中移除 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌。將[red]愚行[/red]加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]。

prismatic gem.name: 稜彩寶石
prismatic gem.en: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. Card rewards now contain cards from other colors.
prismatic gem.tr: 每回合開始時，獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。卡牌獎勵現在會包含其他顏色的卡牌。

pumpkin candle.name: 南瓜蠟燭
pumpkin candle.en: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. Extinguishes after [blue]{CombatCount}[/blue] combats. Can be [gold]Kindled[/gold] at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold].
pumpkin candle.tr: 每回合開始時，獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。經過 [blue]{CombatCount}[/blue] 場戰鬥後熄滅。可在[gold]休息處[/gold]進行[gold]重新點燃[/gold]。

punch dagger.name: 拳刃
punch dagger.tr: 拾取時，為一張攻擊牌[gold]附魔[/gold]上[purple]動量[/purple] [blue]{Momentum}[/blue]。

radiant pearl.name: 光輝珍珠
radiant pearl.en: At the start of each combat, add [blue]{Cards}[/blue] [gold]{Cards:plural:Luminesce|Luminesces}[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
radiant pearl.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，將 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張[gold]幽光[/gold]加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

rainbow ring.name: 彩虹戒指
rainbow ring.en: The first time you play an Attack, Skill, and Power each turn, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
rainbow ring.tr: 你每回合第一次打出攻擊牌、技能牌與能力牌各一張時，獲得 [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] 層[gold]力量[/gold]和 [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] 層[gold]敏捷[/gold]。

razor tooth.name: 剃刀牙
razor tooth.en: Every time you play an Attack or Skill, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it for the remainder of combat.
razor tooth.tr: 每當你打出一張攻擊牌或技能牌時，在本場戰鬥中將其[gold]升級[/gold]。

red mask.name: 紅面具
red mask.en: At the start of each combat, apply [blue]{WeakPower}[/blue] [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies.
red mask.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，對所有敵人施加 [blue]{WeakPower}[/blue] 層[gold]虛弱[/gold]。

red skull.name: 紅頭骨
red skull.en: While your HP is at or below [blue]{HpThreshold}%[/blue], you have [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] additional [gold]Strength[/gold].
red skull.tr: 當你的生命不高於 [blue]{HpThreshold}%[/blue] 時，你額外擁有 [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] 層[gold]力量[/gold]。

red vine tea.name: 赤藤茶
red vine tea.en: At the start of the next {Combats:plural:combat|[blue]{}[/blue] combats}, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
red vine tea.tr: 接下來 [blue]{Combats}[/blue] 場戰鬥開始時，額外抽 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌。

regalite.name: 皇室礦
regalite.en: The first time you create a card each turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
regalite.tr: 你每回合第一次創造一張牌時，獲得 [blue]{Block}[/blue] 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

regal pillow.name: 皇室枕頭
regal pillow.en: Whenever you [gold]Rest[/gold], heal an additional [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP.
regal pillow.tr: 每當你[gold]休息[/gold]時，額外恢復 [blue]{Heal}[/blue] 點生命。

reptile trinket.name: 爬蟲飾品
reptile trinket.en: Whenever you use a potion, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
reptile trinket.tr: 每當你使用一瓶藥水時，本回合獲得 [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] 層[gold]力量[/gold]。

ringing triangle.name: 鳴響三角鐵
ringing triangle.en: [gold]Retain[/gold] your [gold]Hand[/gold] on the first turn of combat.
ringing triangle.tr: 戰鬥的第一個回合會[gold]保留[/gold]你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

ring of the drake.name: 長蛇戒指
ring of the drake.en: At the start of your first {Turns:plural:turn|[blue]{}[/blue] turns}, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
ring of the drake.tr: 你的前 [blue]{Turns}[/blue] 個回合開始時，額外抽 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌。

ring of the snake.name: 蛇之戒指
ring of the snake.en: At the start of each combat, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
ring of the snake.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，額外抽 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌。

ripple basin.name: 波紋水盆
ripple basin.en: If you did not play any Attacks during your turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
ripple basin.tr: 若你的回合中未打出任何攻擊牌，就獲得 [blue]{Block}[/blue] 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

royal poison.name: 王室毒藥
royal poison.en: At the start of each combat, lose [blue]{Damage}[/blue] HP.
royal poison.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，失去 [blue]{Damage}[/blue] 點生命。

royal stamp.name: 王室印章
royal stamp.en: Upon pickup, choose an Attack or Skill in your [gold]Deck[/gold] to [gold]Enchant[/gold] with [purple]{Enchantment}[/purple].
royal stamp.tr: 拾取時，從你的[gold]牌組[/gold]中選擇一張攻擊牌或技能牌，為其[gold]附魔[/gold]上[purple]{Enchantment}[/purple]。

ruined helmet.name: 破損頭盔
ruined helmet.en: The first time you gain [gold]Strength[/gold] each combat, double the amount gained.
ruined helmet.tr: 每場戰鬥中你第一次獲得[gold]力量[/gold]時，使該次獲得量加倍。

runic capacitor.name: 符文電容器
runic capacitor.en: Start each combat with [blue]{Repeat}[/blue] additional [gold]Orb Slots[/gold].
runic capacitor.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，額外擁有 [blue]{Repeat}[/blue] 個[gold]充能球欄位[/gold]。

runic pyramid.name: 符文金字塔
runic pyramid.en: At the end of your turn, you no longer discard your [gold]Hand[/gold].
runic pyramid.tr: 在你的回合結束時，你不再丟棄[gold]手牌[/gold]。

sai.name: 釵
sai.en: At the start of your turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
sai.tr: 在你的回合開始時，獲得 [blue]{Block}[/blue] 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

sand castle.name: 沙堡
sand castle.tr: 拾取時，[gold]升級[/gold] [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張隨機卡牌。

screaming flagon.name: 尖叫酒壺
screaming flagon.en: If you end your turn with no cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold], deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
screaming flagon.tr: 若你結束回合時[gold]手牌[/gold]中沒有牌，對所有敵人造成 [blue]{Damage}[/blue] 點傷害。

scroll boxes.name: 卷軸箱
scroll boxes.en: Upon pickup, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]2[/blue] packs of cards to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
scroll boxes.tr: 拾取時，從 [blue]2[/blue] 組卡牌中選擇 [blue]1[/blue] 組加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]。

seal of gold.name: 黃金印記
seal of gold.en: At the start of your turn, spend [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] to gain {Energy:energyIcons()}.
seal of gold.tr: 在你的回合開始時，花費 [blue]{Gold}[/blue] 枚[gold]金幣[/gold]，獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。

sea glass.name: 海玻璃
sea glass.en: See [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards from {Character.StringValue:cond:[gold]{}[/gold]|another character}. Choose any number of them to add to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
sea glass.tr: 查看來自{Character.StringValue:cond:[gold]{}[/gold]|其他角色}的 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌。選擇任意數量加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]。

self-forming clay.name: 自塑黏土
self-forming clay.en: Whenever you lose HP in combat, gain [blue]{BlockNextTurn}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold] next turn.
self-forming clay.tr: 每當你在戰鬥中失去生命，下回合就獲得 [blue]{BlockNextTurn}[/blue] 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

sere talon.name: 枯萎之爪
sere talon.en: Upon pickup, lose [blue]9[/blue] Max HP. Add [blue]{Wishes}[/blue] [purple]Wishes[/purple] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
sere talon.tr: 拾取時，失去 [blue]9[/blue] 點最大生命。將 [blue]{Wishes}[/blue] 張[purple]祈願[/purple]加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]。

shovel.name: 鏟子
shovel.en: You can now dig at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold] to obtain a random [gold]Relic[/gold].
shovel.tr: 你現在可以在[gold]休息處[/gold]挖掘，以獲得一件隨機[gold]遺物[/gold]。

shuriken.name: 手裏劍
shuriken.en: Every time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Attacks in a single turn, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
shuriken.tr: 每當你在單一回合中打出 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張攻擊牌時，獲得 [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] 層[gold]力量[/gold]。

signet ring.name: 印戒
signet ring.tr: 拾取時，獲得 [blue]{Gold}[/blue] 枚[gold]金幣[/gold]。

silken tress.name: 絲綢髮束
silken tress.en: Upon pickup, lose all [gold]Gold[/gold]. [gold]Enchant[/gold] all cards in your first card reward with [purple]Glam[/purple].
silken tress.tr: 拾取時，失去所有[gold]金幣[/gold]。為你首次卡牌獎勵中的所有卡牌[gold]附魔[/gold]上[purple]華彩[/purple]。

silver crucible.name: 白銀坩堝
silver crucible.en: The first [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card rewards you see are [gold]Upgraded[/gold]. The first Treasure Chest you open is [red]empty[/red].
silver crucible.tr: 你看到的前 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 份卡牌獎勵中的卡牌皆為[gold]已升級[/gold]版本。你開啟的第一個財寶箱是[red]空的[/red]。

sling of courage.name: 勇氣投石索
sling of courage.tr: 每場[gold]菁英[/gold]戰鬥開始時，獲得 [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] 層[gold]力量[/gold]。

small capsule.name: 小型扭蛋
small capsule.tr: 拾取時，獲得一件隨機[gold]遺物[/gold]。

snecko eye.name: 異蛇之眼
snecko eye.en: At the start of your turn, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] additional {Cards:plural:card|cards}. Start each combat [red]Confused[/red].
snecko eye.tr: 在你的回合開始時，額外抽 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌。每場戰鬥開始時處於[red]混亂[/red]狀態。

snecko skull.name: 異蛇頭骨
snecko skull.en: Whenever you apply [gold]Poison[/gold], apply an additional [blue]{PoisonPower}[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold].
snecko skull.tr: 每當你施加[gold]中毒[/gold]時，額外施加 [blue]{PoisonPower}[/blue] 層[gold]中毒[/gold]。

sozu.name: 添水
sozu.en: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. You can no longer obtain [gold]Potions[/gold].
sozu.tr: 每回合開始時，獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。你無法再取得[gold]藥水[/gold]。

sparkling rouge.name: 閃亮口紅
sparkling rouge.en: At the start of your [blue]3rd[/blue] turn, gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] and [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
sparkling rouge.tr: 在你的第 [blue]3[/blue] 個回合開始時，獲得 [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] 層[gold]力量[/gold]和 [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] 層[gold]敏捷[/gold]。

spiked gauntlets.name: 帶刺護手
spiked gauntlets.en: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. Powers cost [blue]1[/blue] more {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}.
spiked gauntlets.tr: 每回合開始時，獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。能力牌的耗能增加 [blue]1[/blue] {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}。

stone calendar.name: 石製日曆
stone calendar.en: At the end of turn [blue]{DamageTurn}[/blue], deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL enemies.
stone calendar.tr: 在第 [blue]{DamageTurn}[/blue] 個回合結束時，對所有敵人造成 [blue]{Damage}[/blue] 點傷害。

stone cracker.name: 碎石器
stone cracker.en: At the start of each combat, [gold]Upgrade[/gold] [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random {Cards:plural:card|cards} in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] for the rest of combat.
stone cracker.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，[gold]升級[/gold]你[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]中的 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張隨機卡牌，持續至本場戰鬥結束。

stone humidifier.name: 石製加濕器
stone humidifier.en: Whenever you [gold]Rest[/gold] at a [gold]Rest Site[/gold], raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
stone humidifier.tr: 每當你在[gold]休息處[/gold]進行[gold]休息[/gold]時，使你的最大生命提高 [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] 點。

storybook.name: 故事書
storybook.en: Upon pickup, add [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Brightest Flame[/gold] to your [gold]Deck[/gold].
storybook.tr: 拾取時，將 [blue]1[/blue] 張[gold]至明烈焰[/gold]加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]。

strawberry.name: 草莓
strawberry.en: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
strawberry.tr: 拾取時，使你的最大生命提高 [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] 點。

strike dummy.name: 打擊木偶
strike dummy.tr: 名稱中含有「打擊」的卡牌額外造成 [blue]{ExtraDamage}[/blue] 點傷害。

sturdy clamp.name: 堅固夾具
sturdy clamp.tr: 最多 [blue]{Block}[/blue] 點[gold]格擋[/gold]會保留至下回合。

sword of jade.name: 玉劍
sword of jade.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，獲得 [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] 層[gold]力量[/gold]。

sword of stone.name: 石之劍
sword of stone.en: Transforms into a powerful [gold]Relic[/gold] after defeating [blue]{Elites}[/blue] [gold]{Elites:plural:Elite|Elites}[/gold].
sword of stone.tr: 擊敗 [blue]{Elites}[/blue] 名[gold]菁英[/gold]後，轉化為一件強大的[gold]遺物[/gold]。

symbiotic virus.name: 共生病毒
symbiotic virus.en: At the start of each combat, [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]{Dark}[/blue] [gold]Dark[/gold].
symbiotic virus.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，[gold]凝聚[/gold] [blue]{Dark}[/blue] 個[gold]黑暗[/gold]充能球。

tanx's whistle.name: 坦克斯的哨子
tanx's whistle.tr: 拾取時，將 [blue]1[/blue] 張[gold]吹哨[/gold]加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]。

tea of discourtesy.name: 無禮之茶
tea of discourtesy.en: At the start of the next combat, shuffle [blue]{DazedCount}[/blue] [gold]Dazed[/gold] into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
tea of discourtesy.tr: 下一場戰鬥開始時，將 [blue]{DazedCount}[/blue] 張[gold]暈眩[/gold]牌洗入你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]。

the abacus.name: 算盤
the abacus.en: Whenever you shuffle your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
the abacus.tr: 每當你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]洗牌時，獲得 [blue]{Block}[/blue] 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

the boot.name: 發條靴
the boot.en: Whenever you would deal [blue]{DamageThreshold}[/blue] or less unblocked attack damage, increase it to [blue]{DamageMinimum}[/blue].
the boot.tr: 每當你的攻擊造成不高於 [blue]{DamageThreshold}[/blue] 點的未被格擋傷害時，將其提高至 [blue]{DamageMinimum}[/blue] 點。

the courier.name: 送貨員
the courier.en: The merchant no longer runs out of cards, relics, or potions and his prices are reduced by [blue]{Discount}%[/blue].
the courier.tr: 商人不會售罄卡牌、遺物或藥水，且所有商品價格降低 [blue]{Discount}%[/blue]。

throwing axe.name: 飛斧
throwing axe.en: The first card you play each combat is played an extra time.
throwing axe.tr: 每場戰鬥中你打出的第一張牌會額外打出一次。

tingsha.name: 銅鈸
tingsha.en: Whenever you discard a card during your turn, deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to a random enemy for each card discarded.
tingsha.tr: 你在自己的回合中每丟棄一張牌，就對一名隨機敵人造成 [blue]{Damage}[/blue] 點傷害。

tiny mailbox.name: 迷你郵箱
tiny mailbox.tr: 每當你[gold]休息[/gold]時，取得 [blue]2[/blue] 瓶隨機[gold]藥水[/gold]。

toasty mittens.name: 暖烘烘手套
toasty mittens.en: At the start of your turn, [gold]Exhaust[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] card from your [gold]Hand[/gold] and gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
toasty mittens.tr: 在你的回合開始時，從你的[gold]手牌[/gold]中[gold]消耗[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] 張牌，並獲得 [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] 層[gold]力量[/gold]。

toolbox.name: 工具箱
toolbox.en: At the start of each combat, choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]{Cards}[/blue] random Colorless cards and add the chosen card into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
toolbox.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，從 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張隨機無色牌中選擇 [blue]1[/blue] 張加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

touch of orobas.name: 歐洛巴斯之觸
touch of orobas.en: Upon pickup, replace {StarterRelic.StringValue:cond:[gold]{StarterRelic}[/gold] with [gold]{UpgradedRelic}[/gold]|your starter [gold]Relic[/gold] with an [gold]Ancient[/gold] version}.
touch of orobas.tr: 拾取時，將{StarterRelic.StringValue:cond:[gold]{StarterRelic}[/gold]替換為[gold]{UpgradedRelic}[/gold]|你的起始[gold]遺物[/gold]替換為[gold]遠古[/gold]版本}。

tough bandages.name: 堅韌繃帶
tough bandages.en: Whenever you discard a card during your turn, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
tough bandages.tr: 每當你在自己的回合中丟棄一張牌時，獲得 [blue]{Block}[/blue] 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

toxic egg.name: 毒素之蛋
toxic egg.en: Whenever you add a Skill into your [gold]Deck[/gold], [gold]Upgrade[/gold] it.
toxic egg.tr: 每當你將一張技能牌加入你的[gold]牌組[/gold]時，將其[gold]升級[/gold]。

toy box.name: 玩具箱
toy box.en: Upon pickup, obtain [blue]{Relics}[/blue] [gold]Wax {Relics:plural:Relic|Relics}[/gold]. Every [blue]{Combats}[/blue] {Combats:plural:combat|combats}, your left-most [gold]Wax Relic[/gold] will melt away.
toy box.tr: 拾取時，獲得 [blue]{Relics}[/blue] 件[gold]蠟製遺物[/gold]。每經過 [blue]{Combats}[/blue] 場戰鬥，最左側的[gold]蠟製遺物[/gold]就會融化。

tri-boomerang.name: 三刃迴力鏢
tri-boomerang.tr: 從你的[gold]牌組[/gold]中選擇 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張攻擊牌，為其[gold]附魔[/gold]上[purple]本能[/purple]。

tungsten rod.name: 鎢合金棒
tungsten rod.en: Whenever you would lose HP, lose [blue]{HpLossReduction}[/blue] less.
tungsten rod.tr: 每當你即將失去生命時，少失去 [blue]{HpLossReduction}[/blue] 點生命。

tuning fork.name: 音叉
tuning fork.en: Every time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] Skills, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
tuning fork.tr: 每打出 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張技能牌，就獲得 [blue]{Block}[/blue] 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

twisted funnel.name: 扭曲漏斗
twisted funnel.en: At the start of each combat, apply [blue]{PoisonPower}[/blue] [gold]Poison[/gold] to ALL enemies.
twisted funnel.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，對所有敵人施加 [blue]{PoisonPower}[/blue] 層[gold]中毒[/gold]。

unceasing top.name: 不休陀螺
unceasing top.en: Whenever you have no cards in [gold]Hand[/gold] during your turn, draw a card.
unceasing top.tr: 每當你在自己的回合中[gold]手牌[/gold]為空時，抽一張牌。

undying sigil.name: 不死印記
undying sigil.en: Enemies with at least as much [gold]Doom[/gold] as HP deal [blue]50%[/blue] less damage.
undying sigil.tr: 若敵人的[gold]惡兆[/gold]層數不低於其生命，該敵人造成的傷害減少 [blue]50%[/blue]。

unsettling lamp.name: 不安油燈
unsettling lamp.en: Each combat, the first time you play a card that [gold]Debuffs[/gold] an enemy, double its effect.
unsettling lamp.tr: 每場戰鬥中，你第一次打出會對敵人施加[gold]弱化效果[/gold]的牌時，使其效果加倍。

vajra.name: 金剛杵
vajra.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，獲得 [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] 層[gold]力量[/gold]。

vambrace.name: 臂鎧
vambrace.en: The first time you gain [gold]Block[/gold] from a card each combat, double the amount gained.
vambrace.tr: 每場戰鬥中，你第一次透過卡牌獲得[gold]格擋[/gold]時，獲得量加倍。

velvet choker.name: 天鵝絨頸圈
velvet choker.en: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. You cannot play more than [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards} per turn.
velvet choker.tr: 每回合開始時，獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。你每回合最多只能打出 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌。

venerable tea set.name: 古老茶具組
venerable tea set.en: Whenever you enter a [gold]Rest Site[/gold], start the next combat with an additional {Energy:energyIcons()}.
venerable tea set.tr: 每當你進入[gold]休息處[/gold]時，下一場戰鬥開始時額外獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。

very hot cocoa.name: 滾燙可可
very hot cocoa.en: Start each combat with an additional [blue]{Energy:energyIcons()}[/blue].
very hot cocoa.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，額外獲得 [blue]{Energy:energyIcons()}[/blue]。

vexing puzzlebox.name: 惱人謎盒
vexing puzzlebox.en: At the start of each combat, add a random card into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this turn.
vexing puzzlebox.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時，將一張隨機卡牌加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。該牌本回合可免費打出。

vine bracelet.name: 藤蔓手環
vine bracelet.en: Upon pickup, raise your Max HP by [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue].
vine bracelet.tr: 拾取時，使你的最大生命提高 [blue]{MaxHp}[/blue] 點。

vitruvian minion.name: 維特魯威手下
vitruvian minion.en: Cards containing “Minion” deal double damage and gain double [gold]Block[/gold].
vitruvian minion.tr: 名稱中含有「手下」的卡牌造成雙倍傷害，並獲得雙倍[gold]格擋[/gold]。

war hammer.name: 戰鎚
war hammer.tr: 每當你擊殺一名[gold]菁英[/gold]時，[gold]升級[/gold] [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張隨機卡牌。

war paint.name: 戰紋塗料
war paint.tr: 拾取時，[gold]升級[/gold] [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張隨機技能牌。

whetstone.name: 磨刀石
whetstone.tr: 拾取時，[gold]升級[/gold] [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張隨機攻擊牌。

whispering earring.name: 低語耳環
whispering earring.en: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn. [red]Vakuu plays your first turn for you.[/red]
whispering earring.tr: 每回合開始時，獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。[red]瓦庫會替你進行第一個回合。[/red]

white beast statue.name: 白獸雕像
white beast statue.tr: 戰鬥獎勵中總會出現[gold]藥水[/gold]。

white star.name: 白色星星
white star.tr: [gold]菁英[/gold]會額外掉落一份[gold]稀有[/gold]卡牌獎勵。

winged boots.name: 有翼靴
winged boots.en: You may ignore paths when choosing the next rooms to travel to [blue]{Rooms}[/blue] times.
winged boots.tr: 選擇接下來要前往的房間時，你可以無視地圖路徑 [blue]{Rooms}[/blue] 次。

wing charm.name: 羽翼護符
wing charm.en: A random card in each card reward is [gold]Enchanted[/gold] with [purple]Swift[/purple] [blue]{SwiftAmount}[/blue].
wing charm.tr: 每份卡牌獎勵中，會為一張隨機卡牌[gold]附魔[/gold]上[purple]迅捷[/purple] [blue]{SwiftAmount}[/blue]。

wongo's mystery ticket.name: 萬戈的神祕票券
wongo's mystery ticket.tr: 經過 [blue]{RemainingCombats}[/blue] 場戰鬥後，獲得 [blue]{Repeat}[/blue] 件隨機[gold]遺物[/gold]。

ambergris.name: 龍涎香
ambergris.en: Heal for [green]{HealPercent}%[/green] of your Max HP. If used in combat, take an extra turn.
ambergris.tr: 恢復相當於最大生命 [green]{HealPercent}%[/green] 的生命。若在戰鬥中使用，則額外進行一個回合。

ashwater.name: 灰燼水
ashwater.en: [gold]Exhaust[/gold] any number of cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold].
ashwater.tr: [gold]消耗[/gold]你[gold]手牌[/gold]中任意數量的牌。

attack potion.name: 攻擊藥水
attack potion.en: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] random Attack cards to add into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this turn.
attack potion.tr: 從 [blue]3[/blue] 張隨機攻擊牌中選擇 [blue]1[/blue] 張加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。本回合可免費打出。

beetle juice.name: 甲蟲汁
beetle juice.en: Enemy's attacks deal [blue]{DamageDecrease}%[/blue] less damage {Repeat:plural:next turn|for the next [blue]{}[/blue] turns}.
beetle juice.tr: 敵人的攻擊在{Repeat:choose:下|接下來 [blue]{}[/blue] }回合傷害減少 [blue]{DamageDecrease}%[/blue]。

blessing of the forge.name: 鑄爐祝福
blessing of the forge.en: [gold]Upgrade[/gold] all cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] for the rest of combat.
blessing of the forge.tr: 在本場戰鬥中[gold]升級[/gold]你[gold]手牌[/gold]中的所有卡牌。

blood potion.name: 血液藥水
blood potion.en: Heal for [green]{HealPercent}%[/green] of your Max HP.
blood potion.tr: 恢復相當於最大生命 [green]{HealPercent}%[/green] 的生命。

bottled potential.name: 瓶裝潛能
bottled potential.en: Shuffle ALL your cards into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold]. Draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}.
bottled potential.tr: 將你的所有牌洗入[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]。抽 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌。

clarity extract.name: 明晰萃取物
clarity extract.en: Draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] {Cards:plural:card|cards}. At the start of your next {ClarityPower:plural:turn|[blue]{}[/blue] turns}, draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card.
clarity extract.tr: 抽 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌。你的下 [blue]{ClarityPower}[/blue] 回合開始時，額外抽 [blue]1[/blue] 張牌。

colorless potion.name: 無色藥水
colorless potion.en: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] random Colorless cards to add into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this turn.
colorless potion.tr: 從 [blue]3[/blue] 張隨機無色牌中選擇 [blue]1[/blue] 張加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。本回合可免費打出。

cosmic concoction.name: 宇宙調製劑
cosmic concoction.tr: 將 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張[gold]已升級[/gold]的無色牌加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

cunning potion.name: 狡猾藥水
cunning potion.tr: 將 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張[gold]已升級的小刀[/gold]加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

deprecated potion.name: 已棄用藥水
deprecated potion.en: This potion has been removed from the game.
deprecated potion.tr: 此藥水已從遊戲中移除。

distilled chaos.name: 精煉混沌
distilled chaos.en: Play the top [blue]{Repeat}[/blue] cards of your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold].
distilled chaos.tr: 打出你[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]頂部的 [blue]{Repeat}[/blue] 張牌。

droplet of precognition.name: 預知露滴
droplet of precognition.en: Choose a card in your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold] and add it into your [gold]Hand[/gold].
droplet of precognition.tr: 從你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]中選擇一張牌，將其加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

duplicator.name: 複製劑
duplicator.en: This turn, your next card is played an extra time.
duplicator.tr: 本回合，你的下一張牌會額外打出一次。

entropic brew.name: 熵之釀
entropic brew.en: Fill all your empty potion slots with random potions.
entropic brew.tr: 以隨機藥水填滿所有空的藥水欄位。

essence of darkness.name: 黑暗精華
essence of darkness.en: [gold]Channel[/gold] a [gold]Dark[/gold] for each of your [gold]Orb Slots[/gold].
essence of darkness.tr: 你每有一個[gold]充能球欄位[/gold]，就[gold]凝聚[/gold] 1 個[gold]黑暗[/gold]。

explosive ampoule.name: 爆炸安瓿
explosive ampoule.tr: 對所有敵人造成 [blue]{Damage}[/blue] 點傷害。

fairy in a bottle.name: 瓶中精靈
fairy in a bottle.en: When your HP would be reduced to [blue]0[/blue], instead this potion is discarded and you heal to [blue]30%[/blue] of your Max HP.
fairy in a bottle.tr: 當你的生命即將降至 [blue]0[/blue] 時，改為丟棄此藥水，並將生命恢復至最大生命的 [blue]30%[/blue]。

flex potion.name: 肌肉藥水
flex potion.en: Gain [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold]. At the end of your turn, lose [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold].
flex potion.tr: 獲得 [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] 層[gold]力量[/gold]。在你的回合結束時，失去 [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] 層[gold]力量[/gold]。

foul potion.name: 惡臭藥水
foul potion.en:
Deal [blue]{Damage}[/blue] damage to ALL players and enemies.
Can be thrown at the [gold]Merchant[/gold] for [blue]{Gold}[/blue] [gold]Gold[/gold] instead.
foul potion.tr:
對所有玩家與敵人造成 [blue]{Damage}[/blue] 點傷害。
也可以將其丟向[gold]商人[/gold]，換取 [blue]{Gold}[/blue] 枚[gold]金幣[/gold]。

fysh oil.name: 異魚油
fysh oil.tr: 獲得 [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] 層[gold]力量[/gold]和 [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] 層[gold]敏捷[/gold]。

gambler's brew.name: 賭徒特調
gambler's brew.en: Discard any number of cards, then draw that many.
gambler's brew.tr: 丟棄任意數量的牌，然後抽取等量的牌。

gigantification potion.name: 超巨化藥水
gigantification potion.en: The next Attack you play deals triple damage.
gigantification potion.tr: 你打出的下一張攻擊牌會造成三倍傷害。

liquid memories.name: 液態記憶
liquid memories.en: Put a card from your [gold]Discard Pile[/gold] into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this turn.
liquid memories.tr: 將你[gold]棄牌堆[/gold]中的一張牌放入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。本回合可免費打出。

mock discard and add shivs potion.name: Mock Discard and Add Shivs Potion

orobic acid.name: 歐洛巴斯酸
orobic acid.en: Add a random Attack, Skill, and Power into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. They're free to play this turn.
orobic acid.tr: 分別將一張隨機攻擊牌、技能牌與能力牌加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。這些牌本回合可免費打出。

potion of binding.name: 禁縛藥水
potion of binding.tr: 對所有敵人施加 [blue]{WeakPower:diff()}[/blue] 層[gold]虛弱[/gold]和 [blue]{VulnerablePower:diff()}[/blue] 層[gold]易傷[/gold]。

potion of capacity.name: 擴容藥水
potion of capacity.tr: 獲得 [blue]{Repeat}[/blue] 個[gold]充能球欄位[/gold]。

pot of ghouls.name: 屍鬼甕
pot of ghouls.tr: 將 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張[gold]靈魂[/gold]加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

powdered demise.name: 消亡粉末
powdered demise.en: Enemy loses [blue]{Demise}[/blue] HP at the end of each of its turns.
powdered demise.tr: 敵人在其每個回合結束時失去 [blue]{Demise}[/blue] 點生命。

power potion.name: 能力藥水
power potion.en: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] random Power cards to add into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this turn.
power potion.tr: 從 [blue]3[/blue] 張隨機能力牌中選擇 [blue]1[/blue] 張加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。本回合可免費打出。

radiant tincture.name: 光輝酊劑
radiant tincture.en: Gain {Energy:energyIcons()}. Gain an additional {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} at the start of your next [blue]{RadiancePower}[/blue] {RadiancePower:plural:turn|turns}.
radiant tincture.tr: 獲得 {Energy:energyIcons()}。接下來 [blue]{RadiancePower}[/blue] 回合開始時，額外獲得 {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}。

shackling potion.name: 鐐銬藥水
shackling potion.tr: 所有敵人本回合失去 [blue]{StrengthPower}[/blue] 層[gold]力量[/gold]。

ship in a bottle.name: 瓶中船
ship in a bottle.tr: 獲得 [blue]{Block:diff()}[/blue] 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。下回合，獲得 [blue]{Block:diff()}[/blue] 點[gold]格擋[/gold]。

skill potion.name: 技能藥水
skill potion.en: Choose [blue]1[/blue] of [blue]3[/blue] random Skill cards to add into your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It's free to play this turn.
skill potion.tr: 從 [blue]3[/blue] 張隨機技能牌中選擇 [blue]1[/blue] 張加入你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。本回合可免費打出。

snecko oil.name: 異蛇油
snecko oil.en: Draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards. Randomize the cost of cards in your [gold]Hand[/gold] this turn.
snecko oil.tr: 抽 [blue]{Cards}[/blue] 張牌。本回合隨機改變你[gold]手牌[/gold]中卡牌的耗能。

soldier's stew.name: 士兵燉湯
soldier's stew.en: All cards containing [gold]Strike[/gold] gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Replay[/gold] this combat.
soldier's stew.tr: 所有名稱中含有[gold]打擊[/gold]的牌在本場戰鬥中獲得[gold]重演[/gold] [blue]1[/blue]。

speed potion.name: 速度藥水
speed potion.en: Gain [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold]. At the end of your turn, lose [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] [gold]Dexterity[/gold].
speed potion.tr: 獲得 [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] 層[gold]敏捷[/gold]。在你的回合結束時，失去 [blue]{DexterityPower}[/blue] 層[gold]敏捷[/gold]。

stable serum.name: 穩定血清
stable serum.tr: 接下來 [blue]{Repeat}[/blue] 回合，[gold]保留[/gold]你的[gold]手牌[/gold]。

touch of insanity.name: 瘋狂之觸
touch of insanity.en: Choose a card in your [gold]Hand[/gold]. It is free to play this combat.
touch of insanity.tr: 選擇你[gold]手牌[/gold]中的一張牌。該牌在本場戰鬥中可免費打出。

clone.name: 再製
clone.en: This card can be duplicated at [gold]Rest Sites[/gold].

corrupted.name: 腐化
corrupted.en: Deal [blue]50%[/blue] more damage, but lose [blue]2[/blue] HP.
corrupted.tr: 造成的傷害提高 [blue]50%[/blue]，但失去 [blue]2[/blue] 點生命。

deprecated.name: 已棄用
deprecated.en: This enchantment has been removed from the game.
deprecated.tr: 此附魔已從遊戲中移除。

glam.name: 華彩
glam.en: This card has [gold]Replay[/gold] once per combat.
glam.tr: 此牌每場戰鬥可[gold]重演[/gold]一次。

goopy.name: 黏糊
goopy.en: This card gains [gold]Exhaust[/gold]. When played, permanently increase this card's [gold]Block[/gold] by [blue]1[/blue].
goopy.tr: 此牌獲得[gold]消耗[/gold]。打出時，就使此牌的[gold]格擋[/gold]永久提高 [blue]1[/blue] 點。

imbued.name: 灌注
imbued.en: This card is played automatically at the start of each combat.
imbued.tr: 每場戰鬥開始時會自動打出此牌。

inky.name: 墨影
inky.tr: 此牌會施加 [blue]{WeakPower}[/blue] 層[gold]虛弱[/gold]。

instinct.name: 本能
instinct.en: This card's attack damage is doubled.

momentum.name: 動量
momentum.en: Increase this card's attack damage by [blue]{Amount}[/blue] this combat when played.
momentum.tr: 打出此牌時，就使其攻擊傷害在本場戰鬥提高 [blue]{Amount}[/blue] 點。

nimble.name: 靈巧
nimble.en: Increases [gold]Block[/gold] gained from this card by [blue]{Amount}[/blue].
nimble.tr: 此牌獲得的[gold]格擋[/gold]提高 [blue]{Amount}[/blue] 點。

perfect fit.name: 完美契合
perfect fit.en: Whenever this would be shuffled into your [gold]Draw Pile[/gold], place it on the top instead.
perfect fit.tr: 每當此牌即將被洗入你的[gold]抽牌堆[/gold]時，改為將其置於牌堆頂部。

sharp.name: 鋒利
sharp.en: Increases damage on this card by [blue]{Amount}[/blue].
sharp.tr: 此牌造成的傷害提高 [blue]{Amount}[/blue] 點。

slither.name: 蛇行
slither.en: When you draw this card, randomize its cost from [blue]0[/blue] to [blue]3[/blue].
slither.tr: 抽到此牌時，將其耗能隨機設為 [blue]0[/blue] 至 [blue]3[/blue]。

slumbering essence.name: 沉眠精華
slumbering essence.en: If this card is in your hand at the end of turn, reduce its cost by [blue]1[/blue] until it is played.
slumbering essence.tr: 若此牌在回合結束時位於你的手牌中，則使其耗能降低 [blue]1[/blue]，直到打出為止。

sown.name: 播種
sown.en: The first time you play this card each combat, gain {Amount:energyIcons()}.
sown.tr: 每場戰鬥中第一次打出此牌時，獲得 {Amount:energyIcons()}。

swift.name: 迅捷
swift.en: The first time you play this card, draw [blue]{Amount}[/blue] {Amount:plural:card|cards}.
swift.tr: 第一次打出此牌時，抽 [blue]{Amount}[/blue] 張牌。

tezcatara's ember.name: 特茲卡塔拉的餘燼
tezcatara's ember.en: Costs [blue]0[/blue], deals [blue]{Damage}[/blue] additional damage, and gains [gold]Eternal[/gold].
tezcatara's ember.tr: 耗能為 [blue]0[/blue]，額外造成 [blue]{Damage}[/blue] 點傷害，並獲得[gold]永恆[/gold]。

vigorous.name: 活力
vigorous.en: The first time this card is played, it deals [blue]{Amount}[/blue] additional damage.
vigorous.tr: 第一次打出此牌時，額外造成 [blue]{Amount}[/blue] 點傷害。
